source.text: רָאִ֨יתִי אֶת־אֲדֹנָ֜י נִצָּ֣ב עַֽל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ וַיֹּאמֶר֩ הַ֨ךְ הַכַּפְתּ֜וֹר וְיִרְעֲשׁ֣וּ הַסִּפִּ֗ים וּבְצַ֨עַם֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ כֻּלָּ֔ם וְאַחֲרִיתָ֖ם בַּחֶ֣רֶב אֶהֱרֹ֑ג לֹֽא־יָנ֤וּס לָהֶם֙ נָ֔ס וְלֹֽא־יִמָּלֵ֥ט לָהֶ֖ם פָּלִֽיט׃

records.literal_gloss: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and he said, Strike the capital, so that the thresholds shake, and break them off on [the] head of all of them; and the last of them by the sword I will kill. Not will flee of them one who flees, and not will escape of them a survivor.

en.L: I saw the Lord standing by the altar, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said: Strike the capitals, so that the thresholds shake, and shatter them on the heads of all of them; \q and the last of them I will kill with the sword; \q not one of them who flees will get away, \q and not one of them who escapes will survive.
en.B: I saw the Lord standing at the altar, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said: Strike the pillar tops until the thresholds shake, and bring them down on the heads of all the people; \q those who are left I will kill with the sword. \q Not one of them will get away; \q not one will escape alive.
en.R: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar. He said: Strike the tops of the temple pillars, so that the whole building shakes down to its foundations. Bring it down on the heads of all the people. \q I will kill with the sword all who are left. \q No one will get away. \q No one will escape.

es.L: Vi al Señor de pie junto al altar, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dijo: Golpea los capiteles para que se estremezcan los umbrales, y hazlos pedazos sobre la cabeza de todos ellos; \q y al último de ellos lo mataré a espada; \q no escapará de ellos ni uno que huya, \q ni se librará de ellos ni uno que escape.
es.B: Vi al Señor de pie junto al altar, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dijo: Golpea lo alto de las columnas hasta que tiemblen los umbrales, y échalos abajo sobre la cabeza de todo el pueblo; \q a los que queden los mataré a espada. \q Ninguno de ellos escapará; \q ninguno saldrá con vida.
es.R: Vi al Señor de pie junto al altar. Él dijo: Golpea la parte de arriba de las columnas del templo, para que todo el edificio tiemble hasta sus cimientos. Échalo abajo sobre la cabeza de toda la gente. \q A todos los que queden los mataré a espada. \q Nadie escapará. \q Nadie se salvará.

fr.L: Je vis le Seigneur debout près de l’autel, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : Frappe les chapiteaux, pour que les seuils tremblent, et brise-les sur la tête de tous ; \q et ce qui reste d’eux, je le tuerai par l’épée ; \q pas un d’entre eux qui fuit ne s’enfuira, \q et pas un d’entre eux qui s’échappe ne sera sauf.
fr.B: Je vis le Seigneur debout près de l’autel, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : Frappe le haut des colonnes jusqu’à faire trembler les seuils, et fais-les s’écrouler sur la tête de tout le peuple ; \q ceux qui resteront, je les tuerai par l’épée. \q Pas un seul ne pourra fuir ; \q pas un seul n’en réchappera.
fr.R: J’ai vu le Seigneur debout près de l’autel. Il a dit : Frappe le haut des colonnes du temple, pour que tout le bâtiment tremble jusqu’à ses fondations. Fais-le s’écrouler sur la tête de tout le peuple. \q Je tuerai par l’épée tous ceux qui resteront. \q Personne ne pourra s’enfuir. \q Personne n’échappera.

sw.L: Nilimwona Bwana amesimama kando ya madhabahu, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akasema: Vipige vichwa vya nguzo, hata vizingiti vitikisike, na uvivunje juu ya vichwa vya wote; \q na wa mwisho wao nitawaua kwa upanga; \q hakuna hata mmoja wao akimbiaye atakayekimbia, \q wala hakuna hata mmoja wao atakayeponyoka akabaki hai.
sw.B: Nilimwona Bwana amesimama madhabahuni, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akasema: Vipige vichwa vya nguzo mpaka vizingiti vitikisike, uviangushe juu ya vichwa vya watu wote; \q wale watakaobaki nitawaua kwa upanga. \q Hakuna hata mmoja wao atakayekimbia; \q hakuna hata mmoja atakayeponyoka akiwa hai.
sw.R: Nilimwona Bwana amesimama kando ya madhabahu. Akasema: Vipige vichwa vya nguzo za hekalu, ili jengo lote litikisike hadi misingi yake. Liangushe juu ya vichwa vya watu wote. \q Nitawaua kwa upanga wote watakaobaki. \q Hakuna atakayekimbia. \q Hakuna atakayeponyoka.

ko.L: 내가 보니 주님께서 제단 곁에 서 계셨다. 그분께서 말씀하셨다. 기둥 머리를 쳐서 문지방들이 흔들리게 하고, 그것들을 부수어 그들 모두의 머리 위에 떨어지게 하여라. \q 그들 가운데 남은 자는 내가 칼로 죽이겠다. \q 그들 가운데 도망하는 자가 하나도 도망하지 못하고, \q 그들 가운데 피하는 자가 하나도 살아남지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 보니 주님께서 제단 곁에 서 계셨다. 그분께서 말씀하셨다. 기둥 머리를 쳐서 문지방이 흔들리게 하고, 그것을 무너뜨려 모든 사람의 머리 위에 떨어지게 하여라. \q 살아남은 자들은 내가 칼로 죽이겠다. \q 그들 가운데 하나도 달아나지 못하고, \q 하나도 살아서 피하지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 보니 주님께서 제단 곁에 서 계셨다. 그분께서 말씀하셨다. 성전 기둥 꼭대기를 쳐서 건물 전체가 기초까지 흔들리게 하여라. 그것이 무너져 모든 사람의 머리 위에 떨어지게 하여라. \q 남은 사람들은 내가 칼로 모두 죽이겠다. \q 아무도 달아나지 못할 것이다. \q 아무도 피하지 못할 것이다.

vi.L: Tôi thấy Chúa đứng bên bàn thờ, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán: Hãy đánh vào các đầu cột, cho các ngưỡng cửa rung chuyển, và đập vỡ chúng trên đầu tất cả bọn chúng; \q còn những kẻ sót lại, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giết bằng gươm; \q không một kẻ nào chạy trốn được thoát, \q và không một kẻ nào trốn khỏi được sống sót.
vi.B: Tôi thấy Chúa đứng bên bàn thờ, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán: Hãy đánh vào các đầu cột cho đến khi các ngưỡng cửa rung chuyển, và cho chúng đổ xuống trên đầu mọi người; \q những kẻ còn lại {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giết bằng gươm. \q Không một kẻ nào chạy thoát được; \q không một kẻ nào trốn khỏi mà còn sống.
vi.R: Tôi thấy Chúa đứng bên bàn thờ. Ngài phán: Hãy đánh vào đầu các cột đền thờ, để cả tòa nhà rung chuyển đến tận nền. Hãy làm cho nó đổ xuống trên đầu mọi người. \q Ta sẽ dùng gươm giết hết những kẻ còn lại. \q Không ai chạy thoát được. \q Không ai trốn khỏi được.

pt.L: Vi o Senhor de pé junto ao altar, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse: Golpeia os capitéis, para que os umbrais tremam, e despedaça-os sobre a cabeça de todos eles; \q e o resto deles matarei à espada; \q não escapará deles nenhum fugitivo, \q e não se salvará deles nenhum sobrevivente.
pt.B: Vi o Senhor de pé junto ao altar, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse: Golpeia o alto das colunas até os umbrais tremerem, e derruba-os sobre a cabeça de todo o povo; \q os que sobrarem eu matarei à espada. \q Nenhum deles vai fugir; \q nenhum vai escapar com vida.
pt.R: Vi o Senhor de pé ao lado do altar. Ele disse: Golpeia o alto das colunas do templo, para que todo o prédio trema até os alicerces. Derruba tudo sobre a cabeça de todo o povo. \q Vou matar à espada todos os que sobrarem. \q Ninguém vai fugir. \q Ninguém vai escapar.

am.L: ጌታን በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ቆሞ አየሁት፤ እርሱም እንዲህ አለ፦ መድረኮቹ እንዲናወጡ ጉልላቶቹን ምታ፤ በሁሉም ራስ ላይ ሰባብራቸው፤ \q ከእነርሱም የቀሩትን በሰይፍ እገድላለሁ፤ \q ከእነርሱ የሚሸሽ አንድ እንኳ አያመልጥም፤ \q ከእነርሱም የሚያመልጥ አንድ እንኳ አይተርፍም።
am.B: ጌታን በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ቆሞ አየሁት፤ እርሱም እንዲህ አለ፦ መድረኮቹ እስኪናወጡ ድረስ የምሰሶዎቹን ጉልላቶች ምታ፤ በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ራስ ላይ አፍርሳቸው፤ \q የቀሩትን በሰይፍ እገድላቸዋለሁ። \q ከእነርሱ አንድ እንኳ አያመልጥም፤ \q አንድ እንኳ በሕይወት አይተርፍም።
am.R: ጌታን በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ቆሞ አየሁት። እርሱም እንዲህ አለ፦ ሕንጻው ሁሉ እስከ መሠረቱ እንዲናወጥ የቤተ መቅደሱን ምሰሶዎች ራስ ምታ። በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ራስ ላይ አፍርሰው። \q የቀሩትን ሁሉ በሰይፍ እገድላለሁ። \q ማንም አያመልጥም። \q ማንም አይተርፍም።

hi.L: मैंने प्रभु को वेदी के पास खड़े देखा, और उन्होंने कहा: खंभों के सिरों पर मारो, कि डेवढ़ियाँ हिल जाएँ, और उन्हें उन सब के सिरों पर गिराकर चूर करो; \q और उनमें से जो बचे रहेंगे उन्हें मैं तलवार से घात करूँगा; \q उनमें से भागनेवाला कोई भाग न निकलेगा, \q और उनमें से बच निकलनेवाला कोई न बचेगा।
hi.B: मैंने प्रभु को वेदी के पास खड़े देखा, और उन्होंने कहा: खंभों के ऊपरी सिरों पर ऐसा प्रहार करो कि डेवढ़ियाँ हिल उठें, और उन्हें सब लोगों के सिरों पर गिरा दो; \q जो बच जाएँगे उन्हें मैं तलवार से मार डालूँगा। \q उनमें से एक भी भाग न सकेगा; \q एक भी जीवित न बचेगा।
hi.R: मैंने प्रभु को वेदी के पास खड़े देखा। उन्होंने कहा: मंदिर के खंभों के ऊपरी सिरों पर प्रहार करो, ताकि सारा भवन नींव तक हिल जाए। उसे सब लोगों के सिरों पर गिरा दो। \q जो बचेंगे, उन सबको मैं तलवार से मार डालूँगा। \q कोई भाग न सकेगा। \q कोई बच न सकेगा।

ru.L: Я видел Господа, стоящего у жертвенника, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сказал: Ударь по капителям, чтобы сотряслись пороги, и разбей их о головы всех их; \q а последних из них {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} убью мечом; \q не убежит из них убегающий, \q и не спасётся из них уцелевший.
ru.B: Я видел Господа, стоящего у жертвенника, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сказал: Ударь по верхушкам колонн, чтобы сотряслись пороги, и обрушь их на головы всего народа; \q а оставшихся {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} убью мечом. \q Ни один из них не убежит, \q ни один не спасётся живым.
ru.R: Я видел Господа, стоящего у жертвенника. Он сказал: Ударь по верхушкам колонн храма, чтобы всё здание затряслось до самого основания. Обрушь его на головы всех людей. \q Всех, кто останется, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} убью мечом. \q Никто не убежит. \q Никто не спасётся.

ja.L: わたしは、主が祭壇のそばに立っておられるのを見た。その方は言われた。柱頭を打て。敷居が揺れ動くように。それらを彼らすべての頭の上に打ち砕け。 \q 彼らの残りの者を、わたしは剣で殺す。 \q 彼らのうち、逃げる者も逃げおおせず、 \q 彼らのうち、逃れる者も助からない。
ja.B: わたしは、主が祭壇のかたわらに立っておられるのを見た。主は言われた。柱の頭を打ち、敷居を揺り動かし、それを民すべての頭の上に崩し落としなさい。 \q 残った者は、わたしが剣で殺す。 \q 彼らのうち、だれ一人逃げられず、 \q だれ一人生きて逃れることはない。
ja.R: わたしは、主が祭壇のそばに立っておられるのを見ました。主は言われました。神殿の柱の頭を打って、建物全体を土台まで揺り動かしなさい。それを民すべての頭の上に崩し落としなさい。 \q 残った者はみな、わたしが剣で殺す。 \q だれも逃げられない。 \q だれも逃れることはできない。

decisions.choice: the fifth vision: Amos sees the Lord himself at the altar
decisions.reason: This last vision does not begin 'Thus the Lord GOD showed me' (7:1, 4, 7; 8:1) and has no dialogue. Amos sees the Lord standing beside the altar, probably at Bethel, the shrine of 7:10-13, and the Lord gives the command to destroy it. The place where Israel went to meet God becomes the place of judgment. Verses 1-4 are an oracle in poetry, the Lord's own words.

decisions.choice: the capitals ... the thresholds: the tops of the pillars and the bases of the doorways, the whole building from top to bottom
decisions.reason: Kaftor is the ornamental top of a pillar (Zephaniah 2:14); saf is the threshold or the base of a doorway. Struck at the top, the building shakes to its foundations. The command is not addressed to anyone named, perhaps to an angel, or to the prophet within the vision.

decisions.choice: shatter them on the heads of all of them: bring the building down on the worshipers
alternatives: cut them all off (kill them all, to the last)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is short and can be read in two ways: the broken capitals are to fall on the heads of the people, or the people are to be 'cut off, all of them'. Either way, those at the shrine die, and the rest of the verse turns to any who escape.

decisions.choice: not one who flees will get away: there will be no survivors
decisions.reason: The pair 'one who flees' and 'one who escapes' says twice that no one will get away. Verses 2-4 then name every place where someone might try to hide.

decisions.choice: the pillar tops (B); the tops of the temple pillars; the whole building ... down to its foundations; all the people (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the capitals are (m2), and say 'all the people' for 'all of them' (m3). Readable says what the shaking of the thresholds means.

decisions.choice: tú in "Golpea"
decisions.reason: The command is singular in the Hebrew, to someone not named, so Spanish uses tú; the Lord's words take no quotation marks, as the English has them.

decisions.choice: "Je vis" (L, B); "J'ai vu" (R) for the fifth vision; the Lord's words that follow take no quotation marks
alternatives: quotation marks for the Lord's words
decisions.reason: Amos's first-person narrative, as in 7:1; the Lord's words run on into the oracle of verses 1-4, and French follows the English in setting them without quotation marks.

decisions.choice: Golpeia, despedaça (tu)
decisions.reason: The command is singular and given to someone not named (m2), perhaps an angel or the prophet; the Lord speaks, so Portuguese uses "tu", the form for God's word to one person. The capitals and thresholds are "capitéis" and "umbrais" at Literal; Balanced and Readable describe them, as the English does.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English spans on the LORD's pronouns in this chapter have no Amharic counterpart.

decisions.choice: the capitals "ጉልላቶች", as 1 Kings 7:16; thresholds "መድረኮች"; the Lord's words without quotation marks, as in the English
decisions.reason: The tops of the pillars keep the temple word of Kings. The English sets no speech marks round the command, so neither does the Amharic, which keeps the record's count of quotations.

decisions.choice: प्रभु (Adonai, no span); खंभों के सिरे, डेवढ़ियाँ
decisions.reason: In the fifth vision Amos sees Adonai (meaning decision m1), so प्रभु stands without the divine_name span. The capitals and thresholds are the building from top to bottom (m2). No deity_pronoun spans in this file, as through Amos.

decisions.choice: капители (L), верхушки колонн (B, R); пороги
decisions.reason: The tops of the pillars and the bases of the doorways, the whole building from top to bottom (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: Господь, with no divine_name setting
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has Adonai here, not the divine name, as in 7:7-8.

decisions.choice: The vision's frame is narrative ("見た" L, B; "見ました" R, with "立っておられる", "言われた"); the Lord's words plain at every level, with no quotation marks, as the English; kaftor "柱頭" (L), "柱の頭" (B, R), sippim "敷居".
decisions.reason: The prophet's first-person narrative rule (7:1); the oracle inside it is verse and plain.

source.text: אִם־יַחְתְּר֣וּ בִשְׁא֔וֹל מִשָּׁ֖ם יָדִ֣י תִקָּחֵ֑ם וְאִֽם־יַעֲלוּ֙ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם מִשָּׁ֖ם אוֹרִידֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: If they dig into Sheol, from there my hand will take them; and if they go up [to] the heavens, from there I will bring them down.

en.L: If they dig into Sheol, \q from there {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand will take them; \q and if they climb up to the heavens, \q from there I will bring them down.
en.B: Though they dig down into Sheol, \q {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand will take them from there; \q though they climb up to the heavens, \q from there I will bring them down.
en.R: Even if they dig down into the grave, \q I will reach down and take them from there. \q Even if they climb up to the sky, \q I will bring them down from there.

es.L: Aunque caven hasta el Seol, \q de allí los tomará {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano; \q y aunque suban a los cielos, \q de allí los haré bajar.
es.B: Aunque caven hasta el lugar de los muertos, \q {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano los sacará de allí; \q aunque suban a los cielos, \q de allí los haré bajar.
es.R: Aunque caven hasta el lugar de los muertos, \q bajaré la mano y los sacaré de allí. \q Aunque suban al cielo, \q de allí los haré bajar.

fr.L: S’ils creusent jusqu’au Shéol, \q de là {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main les prendra ; \q et s’ils montent aux cieux, \q de là je les ferai descendre.
fr.B: Même s’ils creusent jusqu’au séjour des morts, \q {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main les en arrachera ; \q même s’ils montent jusqu’aux cieux, \q je les en ferai descendre.
fr.R: Même s’ils creusent jusqu’au séjour des morts, \q j’irai les y prendre. \q Même s’ils montent jusqu’au ciel, \q je les en ferai descendre.

sw.L: Wajapochimba mpaka Kuzimu, \q mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} utawatoa huko; \q na wajapopanda mpaka mbinguni, \q nitawashusha kutoka huko.
sw.B: Hata wakichimba mpaka Kuzimu, \q mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} utawatoa huko; \q hata wakipanda mpaka mbinguni, \q nitawashusha kutoka huko.
sw.R: Hata wakichimba chini mpaka kaburini, \q nitanyoosha mkono na kuwatoa huko. \q Hata wakipanda juu mpaka angani, \q nitawashusha kutoka huko.

ko.L: 그들이 스올로 파고 들어가도 \q 내 손이 거기서 그들을 붙잡아 오고, \q 그들이 하늘로 올라가도 \q 내가 거기서 그들을 끌어내리겠다.
ko.B: 그들이 스올까지 파고 내려가도 \q 내 손이 거기서 그들을 붙잡아 오고, \q 하늘로 올라가도 \q 내가 거기서 그들을 끌어내리겠다.
ko.R: 그들이 죽은 사람들이 있는 곳까지 땅을 파고 내려가도 \q 나는 손을 뻗어 거기서 그들을 붙잡아 오겠다. \q 그들이 하늘로 올라가도 \q 나는 거기서 그들을 끌어내리겠다.

vi.L: Nếu chúng đào xuống Âm Phủ, \q tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ bắt chúng từ đó; \q và nếu chúng trèo lên các tầng trời, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ kéo chúng xuống từ đó.
vi.B: Dù chúng đào xuống tận Âm Phủ, \q tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ bắt chúng ra khỏi đó; \q dù chúng trèo lên các tầng trời, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ kéo chúng xuống từ đó.
vi.R: Dù chúng đào xuống tận nơi của người chết, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ với tay xuống bắt chúng ra khỏi đó. \q Dù chúng trèo lên tận bầu trời, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ kéo chúng xuống từ đó.

pt.L: Se cavarem até o Sheol, \q dali a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão os tirará; \q e se subirem aos céus, \q dali os farei descer.
pt.B: Ainda que cavem até o mundo dos mortos, \q a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão os tirará de lá; \q ainda que subam aos céus, \q de lá os farei descer.
pt.R: Mesmo que cavem até o mundo dos mortos, \q eu vou descer a mão e tirá-los de lá. \q Mesmo que subam até o céu, \q eu vou trazê-los de lá para baixo.

am.L: ወደ ሲኦል ቢቆፍሩ፣ \q እጄ ከዚያ ትወስዳቸዋለች፤ \q ወደ ሰማያትም ቢወጡ፣ \q ከዚያ አወርዳቸዋለሁ።
am.B: ቆፍረው ወደ ሙታን ዓለም ቢወርዱ እንኳ፣ \q እጄ ከዚያ ትወስዳቸዋለች፤ \q ወደ ሰማይ ቢወጡ እንኳ፣ \q ከዚያ አወርዳቸዋለሁ።
am.R: ቆፍረው ወደ ሙታን ዓለም ቢወርዱ እንኳ፣ \q እጄን ዘርግቼ ከዚያ እወስዳቸዋለሁ። \q ወደ ሰማይ ቢወጡ እንኳ፣ \q ከዚያ አወርዳቸዋለሁ።

hi.L: चाहे वे खोदकर शिओल में उतरें, \q वहाँ से मेरा हाथ उन्हें ले आएगा; \q और चाहे वे आकाश पर चढ़ जाएँ, \q वहाँ से मैं उन्हें उतार लाऊँगा।
hi.B: चाहे वे खोदकर अधोलोक में उतर जाएँ, \q मेरा हाथ उन्हें वहाँ से ले आएगा; \q चाहे वे आकाश पर चढ़ जाएँ, \q मैं उन्हें वहाँ से नीचे उतार लाऊँगा।
hi.R: चाहे वे खोदकर मृत्यु के लोक में उतर जाएँ, \q मैं हाथ बढ़ाकर उन्हें वहाँ से पकड़ लाऊँगा। \q चाहे वे आकाश पर चढ़ जाएँ, \q मैं उन्हें वहाँ से नीचे ले आऊँगा।

ru.L: Если они вкопаются в шеол, \q оттуда возьмёт их {{deity_pronoun:моя|Моя}} рука; \q и если поднимутся на небеса, \q оттуда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} низведу их.
ru.B: Даже если они зароются в мир мёртвых, \q {{deity_pronoun:моя|Моя}} рука возьмёт их оттуда; \q даже если поднимутся на небеса, \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} оттуда сведу их вниз.
ru.R: Даже если они зароются глубоко в землю, в мир мёртвых, \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} протяну руку и достану их оттуда. \q Даже если они поднимутся на небо, \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сведу их оттуда вниз.

ja.L: たとえ彼らが陰府に掘り進んでも、 \q そこからわたしの手が彼らを捕らえる。 \q たとえ彼らが天に上っても、 \q そこからわたしは彼らを引き降ろす。
ja.B: たとえ彼らが陰府まで掘り下っても、 \q わたしの手はそこから彼らを捕らえる。 \q たとえ彼らが天に上っても、 \q わたしはそこから彼らを引き降ろす。
ja.R: たとえ彼らが死者の世界まで掘り下っても、 \q わたしは手を伸ばして、そこから彼らを連れ出す。 \q たとえ彼らが天まで上っても、 \q わたしはそこから彼らを引き降ろす。

decisions.choice: Sheol and the heavens: there is nowhere to hide from God
decisions.reason: Sheol, the place of the dead, is the depth below; the heavens are the height above. Psalm 139:7-12 uses the same pair to say that no one can go where God is not; here it is said as a threat: there is no escape from his judgment. Verses 2-4 name every hiding place: the depths, the heights, the mountain top, the bottom of the sea, and exile.

decisions.choice: the grave (R)
decisions.reason: Sheol is 'the grave' at Readable, as settled for Isaiah.

decisions.choice: "el Seol" (L); "el lugar de los muertos" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Sheol as the Spanish terms note for the prophets sets.

decisions.choice: "le Shéol" (L); "le séjour des morts" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The French prophets' and Psalms' wording for Sheol at each level.

decisions.choice: "Kuzimu" (L, B); "kaburini" (R)
decisions.reason: Sheol is "Kuzimu", as the Psalms and Isaiah; Readable follows the English "the grave", as the term sheet allows at Hosea 13:14.

decisions.choice: Sheol is "스올" (L, B) and "죽은 사람들이 있는 곳" (R)
decisions.reason: The Isaiah wording (Psalm 139:8).

decisions.choice: "Âm Phủ" (L, B); "nơi của người chết" (R)
decisions.reason: Sheol follows the Isaiah note (Psalm 139:8, which this verse echoes).

decisions.choice: o Sheol (L); o mundo dos mortos (B, R)
decisions.reason: Sheol takes the Old Testament terms in Portuguese: "o Sheol" at Literal, "o mundo dos mortos" at Balanced and Readable, where the English Readable says "the grave".

decisions.choice: Sheol "ሲኦል" (L), "የሙታን ዓለም" (B, R); the heavens "ሰማያት" (L), "ሰማይ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the terms lists settle them for the Old Testament; Readable keeps "the world of the dead" where the English says "the grave", since the place, not a single tomb, is meant.

decisions.choice: शिओल (L); अधोलोक (B); मृत्यु का लोक (R)
decisions.reason: Sheol takes the wording per level that Isaiah 14:9 and 38:10 use in this translation.

decisions.choice: шеол (L); мир мёртвых (B, R)
decisions.reason: Sheol as the Pentateuch and poetry notes; Readable keeps "мир мёртвых" where the English says the grave, since that is the Russian Readable form for Sheol.

decisions.choice: She'ol "陰府" (L, B), "死者の世界" (R) although the English R says grave.
decisions.reason: The prophetic convention (ISA 5:14, 14:9) keeps 死者の世界 at R; here Sheol is the farthest depth, set against the heavens.

source.text: וְאִם־יֵחָֽבְאוּ֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הַכַּרְמֶ֔ל מִשָּׁ֥ם אֲחַפֵּ֖שׂ וּלְקַחְתִּ֑ים וְאִם־יִסָּ֨תְר֜וּ מִנֶּ֤גֶד עֵינַי֙ בְּקַרְקַ֣ע הַיָּ֔ם מִשָּׁ֛ם אֲצַוֶּ֥ה אֶת־הַנָּחָ֖שׁ וּנְשָׁכָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And if they hide themselves on [the] top of Carmel, from there I will search and take them; and if they hide from before my eyes on [the] floor of the sea, from there I will command the serpent and it will bite them.

en.L: And if they hide themselves on the top of Carmel, \q from there I will search them out and take them; \q and if they hide from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight on the floor of the sea, \q from there I will command the serpent, and it will bite them.
en.B: Though they hide on the top of Carmel, \q I will search them out and take them from there; \q though they hide from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight on the floor of the sea, \q there I will order the serpent to bite them.
en.R: Even if they hide on top of Mount Carmel, \q I will find them and take them away from there. \q Even if they hide from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} at the bottom of the sea, \q I will order the sea serpent to bite them there.

es.L: Y aunque se escondan en la cumbre del Carmelo, \q allí los buscaré y los tomaré; \q y aunque se oculten de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} vista en el fondo del mar, \q allí mandaré a la serpiente, y los morderá.
es.B: Aunque se escondan en la cumbre del Carmelo, \q los buscaré y los sacaré de allí; \q aunque se oculten de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} vista en el fondo del mar, \q allí ordenaré a la serpiente que los muerda.
es.R: Aunque se escondan en la cumbre del monte Carmelo, \q los encontraré y los sacaré de allí. \q Aunque se escondan de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} en el fondo del mar, \q allí ordenaré a la serpiente marina que los muerda.

fr.L: Et s’ils se cachent au sommet du Carmel, \q de là je les chercherai et les prendrai ; \q et s’ils se dérobent à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux au fond de la mer, \q de là je commanderai au serpent, et il les mordra.
fr.B: Même s’ils se cachent au sommet du Carmel, \q je les y chercherai et je les en tirerai ; \q même s’ils se dérobent à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} regards au fond de la mer, \q là j’ordonnerai au serpent de les mordre.
fr.R: Même s’ils se cachent au sommet du mont Carmel, \q je les trouverai et je les en ferai sortir. \q Même s’ils se cachent loin de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} au fond de la mer, \q j’ordonnerai au serpent de mer de les y mordre.

sw.L: Na wajapojificha juu ya kilele cha Karmeli, \q nitawatafuta huko na kuwatwaa; \q na wajapojificha mbele ya macho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} katika sakafu ya bahari, \q huko nitamwamuru nyoka, naye atawauma.
sw.B: Hata wakijificha juu ya kilele cha Karmeli, \q nitawatafuta na kuwatoa huko; \q hata wakijificha wasionekane na macho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} katika sakafu ya bahari, \q huko nitamwamuru nyoka awaume.
sw.R: Hata wakijificha juu ya mlima Karmeli, \q nitawapata na kuwachukua kutoka huko. \q Hata wakijificha {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nisiwaone chini kabisa ya bahari, \q nitamwamuru nyoka wa baharini awaume huko.

ko.L: 그들이 갈멜 꼭대기에 숨어도 \q 내가 거기서 찾아내어 붙잡아 오고, \q 그들이 내 눈을 피해 바다 밑바닥에 숨어도 \q 내가 거기서 뱀에게 명령하여 그들을 물게 하겠다.
ko.B: 그들이 갈멜 산꼭대기에 숨어도 \q 내가 거기서 그들을 찾아내어 붙잡아 오고, \q 내 눈을 피해 바다 밑바닥에 숨어도 \q 내가 거기서 뱀에게 명령하여 그들을 물게 하겠다.
ko.R: 그들이 갈멜산 꼭대기에 숨어도 \q 나는 그들을 찾아내어 거기서 데려오겠다. \q 그들이 나를 피해 바다 밑바닥에 숨어도 \q 나는 바다 뱀에게 명령하여 거기서 그들을 물게 하겠다.

vi.L: Và nếu chúng ẩn mình trên đỉnh Cạt-mên, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lục soát và bắt chúng từ đó; \q và nếu chúng trốn khỏi mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} dưới đáy biển, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ truyền lệnh cho con rắn từ đó, và nó sẽ cắn chúng.
vi.B: Dù chúng trốn trên đỉnh Cạt-mên, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ lục soát và bắt chúng từ đó; \q dù chúng trốn khỏi mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} dưới đáy biển, \q tại đó {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ truyền cho con rắn cắn chúng.
vi.R: Dù chúng trốn trên đỉnh núi Cạt-mên, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ tìm ra và bắt chúng đi khỏi đó. \q Dù chúng trốn khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} dưới đáy biển, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ truyền cho con rắn biển cắn chúng tại đó.

pt.L: E se se esconderem no cume do Carmelo, \q dali os buscarei e os tirarei; \q e se se esconderem dos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} olhos no fundo do mar, \q dali darei ordem à serpente, e ela os morderá.
pt.B: Ainda que se escondam no alto do Carmelo, \q eu os procurarei e os tirarei de lá; \q ainda que se escondam dos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} olhos no fundo do mar, \q lá mandarei a serpente mordê-los.
pt.R: Mesmo que se escondam no alto do monte Carmelo, \q eu vou encontrá-los e tirá-los de lá. \q Mesmo que se escondam de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} no fundo do mar, \q vou mandar a serpente do mar mordê-los lá.

am.L: በቀርሜሎስም ራስ ላይ ቢሸሸጉ፣ \q ከዚያ ፈልጌ እወስዳቸዋለሁ፤ \q ከዓይኔም ፊት በባሕሩ ወለል ቢደበቁ፣ \q ከዚያ እባቡን አዝዘዋለሁ፤ እርሱም ይነድፋቸዋል።
am.B: በቀርሜሎስ ራስ ላይ ቢሸሸጉ እንኳ፣ \q ፈልጌ ከዚያ እወስዳቸዋለሁ፤ \q ከዓይኔ ርቀው በባሕሩ ወለል ቢደበቁ እንኳ፣ \q በዚያ እንዲነድፋቸው እባቡን አዝዘዋለሁ።
am.R: በቀርሜሎስ ተራራ ራስ ላይ ቢደበቁ እንኳ፣ \q አግኝቼ ከዚያ እወስዳቸዋለሁ። \q ከእኔ ተሰውረው በባሕሩ ጥልቅ ቢደበቁ እንኳ፣ \q በዚያ እንዲነድፋቸው የባሕሩን እባብ አዝዘዋለሁ።

hi.L: और चाहे वे कर्मेल की चोटी पर छिपें, \q वहाँ से मैं उन्हें ढूँढ़कर ले आऊँगा; \q और चाहे वे मेरी आँखों से ओझल होकर समुद्र के तल में छिपें, \q वहाँ से मैं सर्प को आज्ञा दूँगा, और वह उन्हें डसेगा।
hi.B: चाहे वे कर्मेल की चोटी पर छिप जाएँ, \q मैं उन्हें ढूँढ़कर वहाँ से ले आऊँगा; \q चाहे वे मेरी दृष्टि से बचने के लिए समुद्र के तल में छिपें, \q वहाँ मैं सर्प को उन्हें डसने की आज्ञा दूँगा।
hi.R: चाहे वे कर्मेल पर्वत की चोटी पर छिप जाएँ, \q मैं उन्हें ढूँढ़कर वहाँ से ले जाऊँगा। \q चाहे वे मुझसे छिपने के लिए समुद्र के तल में चले जाएँ, \q मैं वहाँ समुद्री सर्प को उन्हें डसने की आज्ञा दूँगा।

ru.L: И если спрячутся на вершине Кармила, \q оттуда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} разыщу и возьму их; \q и если скроются от {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} глаз на дне моря, \q оттуда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} повелю змею, и он ужалит их.
ru.B: Даже если они спрячутся на вершине Кармила, \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} разыщу их и возьму оттуда; \q даже если скроются от {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} глаз на дне моря, \q там {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} прикажу змею ужалить их.
ru.R: Даже если они спрячутся на вершине горы Кармил, \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} найду их и заберу оттуда. \q Даже если они спрячутся от {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} на дне моря, \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} прикажу морскому змею ужалить их там.

ja.L: たとえ彼らがカルメルの頂に身を隠しても、 \q そこでわたしは捜し出して彼らを捕らえる。 \q たとえ彼らがわたしの目を逃れて海の底に隠れても、 \q そこでわたしは蛇に命じ、蛇は彼らをかむ。
ja.B: たとえ彼らがカルメルの頂に隠れても、 \q わたしは彼らを捜し出し、そこから捕らえる。 \q たとえ彼らがわたしの目を逃れて海の底に隠れても、 \q わたしはそこで蛇に命じて、彼らをかませる。
ja.R: たとえ彼らがカルメル山の頂に隠れても、 \q わたしは彼らを見つけ出し、そこから連れて行く。 \q たとえ彼らがわたしから逃れて海の底に隠れても、 \q わたしは海の大蛇に命じて、そこで彼らをかませる。

decisions.choice: the top of Carmel: a high, wooded headland by the sea
decisions.reason: Mount Carmel rises steeply above the Mediterranean, thickly wooded and full of caves (1:2), a good place to hide. Its top is set against the floor of the sea below it.

decisions.choice: the serpent: a sea monster that obeys the LORD
decisions.reason: Nachash is a snake; in the sea it is a sea monster like Leviathan, 'the twisting serpent' (Isaiah 27:1). In other poems such creatures stand for the chaos that opposes God; here the serpent obeys him. Compare 5:19, where the snake bites the man who thinks he is safe at home.

decisions.choice: Mount Carmel; sea serpent (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says that Carmel is a mountain (m1) and that the serpent lives in the sea (m2).

decisions.choice: hannachash "蛇" (L, B), "海の大蛇" (R); Carmel "カルメル" (L, B), "カルメル山" (R), as 1:2.
decisions.reason: A sea monster that obeys the LORD (m2), named at R as the English R.

source.text: וְאִם־יֵלְכ֤וּ בַשְּׁבִי֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹֽיבֵיהֶ֔םמִשָּׁ֛ם אֲצַוֶּ֥ה אֶת־הַחֶ֖רֶב וַהֲרָגָ֑תַם וְשַׂמְתִּ֨י עֵינִ֧י עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם לְרָעָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א לְטוֹבָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And if they go into captivity before their enemies, from there I will command the sword and it will kill them; and I will set my eye on them for evil and not for good.

en.L: And if they go into captivity before their enemies, \q from there I will command the sword, and it will kill them; \q and I will set {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes on them for harm and not for good.
en.B: Though they go into captivity, driven ahead of their enemies, \q there I will command the sword to kill them. \q I will fix {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes on them for harm and not for good.
en.R: Even if their enemies take them away as captives, \q I will command the sword to kill them there. \q I will keep watching them, but to harm them, not to help them.

es.L: Y aunque vayan al cautiverio delante de sus enemigos, \q allí mandaré a la espada, y los matará; \q y pondré {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos sobre ellos para mal y no para bien.
es.B: Aunque vayan al cautiverio, arreados por sus enemigos, \q allí mandaré a la espada que los mate. \q Fijaré {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos sobre ellos para mal y no para bien.
es.R: Aunque sus enemigos se los lleven prisioneros, \q allí mandaré a la espada que los mate. \q Los vigilaré, pero para hacerles daño y no para ayudarlos.

fr.L: Et s’ils vont en captivité devant leurs ennemis, \q de là je commanderai à l’épée, et elle les tuera ; \q et je fixerai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux sur eux pour le mal et non pour le bien.
fr.B: Même s’ils partent en captivité, poussés devant leurs ennemis, \q là j’ordonnerai à l’épée de les tuer. \q Je garderai les yeux fixés sur eux pour leur malheur et non pour leur bien.
fr.R: Même si leurs ennemis les emmènent en captivité, \q j’ordonnerai à l’épée de les tuer là-bas. \q Je continuerai à les surveiller, mais pour leur faire du mal, et non pour les aider.

sw.L: Na wajapokwenda utumwani mbele ya adui zao, \q huko nitauamuru upanga, nao utawaua; \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaweka macho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} juu yao kwa mabaya wala si kwa mema.
sw.B: Hata wakienda utumwani, wakiswagwa mbele ya adui zao, \q huko nitauamuru upanga uwaue. \q Nitayakaza macho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} juu yao kwa mabaya wala si kwa mema.
sw.R: Hata adui zao wakiwachukua mateka, \q nitauamuru upanga uwaue huko. \q Nitaendelea kuwatazama, lakini ili kuwadhuru, wala si kuwasaidia.

ko.L: 그들이 원수들 앞에서 사로잡혀 가도 \q 내가 거기서 칼에게 명령하여 그들을 죽이게 하겠다. \q 내가 그들에게 내 눈을 두되, 복을 주려는 것이 아니라 재앙을 내리려는 것이다.
ko.B: 그들이 원수들에게 쫓겨 사로잡혀 가도 \q 내가 거기서 칼에게 명령하여 그들을 죽이게 하겠다. \q 내가 그들을 지켜보는 것은 잘되게 하려는 것이 아니라 해를 주려는 것이다.
ko.R: 원수들이 그들을 포로로 끌고 가도 \q 나는 거기서 칼에게 명령하여 그들을 죽이게 하겠다. \q 나는 그들을 계속 지켜보겠지만, 돕기 위해서가 아니라 벌하기 위해서이다.

vi.L: Và nếu chúng đi làm phu tù trước mặt kẻ thù, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ truyền lệnh cho gươm từ đó, và nó sẽ giết chúng; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ để mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên chúng để làm hại chứ không phải để làm ơn.
vi.B: Dù chúng bị kẻ thù lùa đi làm phu tù, \q tại đó {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ truyền cho gươm giết chúng. \q Ta sẽ chăm chăm nhìn chúng để giáng họa chứ không phải để ban phước.
vi.R: Dù kẻ thù bắt chúng đi làm phu tù, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ truyền cho gươm giết chúng tại đó. \q Ta sẽ luôn để mắt đến chúng, nhưng để làm hại chứ không phải để giúp đỡ.

pt.L: E se forem para o cativeiro diante dos seus inimigos, \q dali darei ordem à espada, e ela os matará; \q e porei os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} olhos sobre eles para o mal e não para o bem.
pt.B: Ainda que vão para o cativeiro, levados à frente dos seus inimigos, \q lá mandarei a espada matá-los. \q Fixarei os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} olhos sobre eles para o mal e não para o bem.
pt.R: Mesmo que os seus inimigos os levem como prisioneiros, \q vou mandar a espada matá-los lá. \q Vou ficar de olho neles, mas para lhes fazer mal, e não para ajudá-los.

am.L: በጠላቶቻቸውም ፊት ተማርከው ቢሄዱ፣ \q ከዚያ ሰይፍን አዝዛለሁ፤ እርሱም ይገድላቸዋል፤ \q ዓይኔንም ለመልካም ሳይሆን ለክፉ በእነርሱ ላይ አደርጋለሁ።
am.B: በጠላቶቻቸው ፊት እየተነዱ ተማርከው ቢሄዱ እንኳ፣ \q በዚያ እንዲገድላቸው ሰይፍን አዝዛለሁ። \q ዓይኔን ለመልካም ሳይሆን ለክፉ በእነርሱ ላይ አጸናለሁ።
am.R: ጠላቶቻቸው ማርከው ቢወስዷቸው እንኳ፣ \q በዚያ እንዲገድላቸው ሰይፍን አዝዛለሁ። \q እነርሱን መመልከቴን አላቋርጥም፤ ግን ልጎዳቸው እንጂ ልረዳቸው አይደለም።

hi.L: और चाहे वे अपने शत्रुओं के आगे-आगे बँधुआई में जाएँ, \q वहाँ से मैं तलवार को आज्ञा दूँगा, और वह उन्हें घात करेगी; \q और मैं उन पर भलाई के लिए नहीं, बुराई के लिए अपनी आँखें लगाऊँगा।
hi.B: चाहे वे बँधुआई में अपने शत्रुओं के आगे-आगे हाँके जाएँ, \q वहाँ मैं तलवार को उन्हें मार डालने की आज्ञा दूँगा। \q मैं उन पर अपनी आँखें भलाई के लिए नहीं, हानि के लिए लगाए रखूँगा।
hi.R: चाहे उनके शत्रु उन्हें बंदी बनाकर ले जाएँ, \q मैं वहाँ तलवार को उन्हें मार डालने की आज्ञा दूँगा। \q मैं उन पर नज़र रखूँगा, पर उनकी सहायता के लिए नहीं, उन्हें हानि पहुँचाने के लिए।

ru.L: И если пойдут в плен перед своими врагами, \q оттуда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} повелю мечу, и он убьёт их; \q и обращу {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} глаза на них во зло, а не во благо.
ru.B: Даже если их угонят в плен впереди их врагов, \q там {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} повелю мечу убить их. \q Я устремлю на них {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} глаза на беду, а не на добро.
ru.R: Даже если враги уведут их в плен, \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} прикажу мечу убить их там. \q Я буду следить за ними, но чтобы причинить им зло, а не чтобы помочь.

ja.L: たとえ彼らが敵の前を捕囚となって行っても、 \q そこでわたしは剣に命じ、剣は彼らを殺す。 \q わたしは彼らの上に目を据える。災いのためであって、幸いのためではない。
ja.B: たとえ彼らが敵に追い立てられて捕囚として行っても、 \q わたしはそこで剣に命じて彼らを殺させる。 \q わたしは彼らに目を注ぐ。災いを下すためであって、幸いを与えるためではない。
ja.R: たとえ敵が彼らを捕虜にして連れて行っても、 \q わたしはそこで剣に命じて、彼らを殺させる。 \q わたしは彼らを見張り続ける。しかし、それは彼らを助けるためではなく、害するためだ。

decisions.choice: set my eyes on them for harm and not for good: watch them only to punish them
decisions.reason: To set one's eyes on someone usually means to watch over them for their good (Jeremiah 24:6; 39:12). Here it is turned around: the LORD will keep them in view, but to bring disaster on them. Even exile, which might have seemed an escape, is no refuge.

decisions.choice: before their enemies: driven along in front of their captors
decisions.reason: Captives were marched ahead of the conquering army into exile.

decisions.choice: driven ahead of (B); their enemies take them away (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what 'before their enemies' means (m2).

source.text: וַאדֹנָ֨י יְהוִ֜ה הַצְּבָא֗וֹת הַנּוֹגֵ֤עַ בָּאָ֨רֶץ֙ וַתָּמ֔וֹג וְאָבְל֖וּ כָּל־י֣וֹשְׁבֵי בָ֑הּ וְעָלְתָ֤ה כַיְאֹר֙ כֻּלָּ֔הּ וְשָׁקְעָ֖ה כִּיאֹ֥ר מִצְרָֽיִם

records.literal_gloss: And the Lord Yahweh of hosts, who touches the earth and it melts, and all who dwell in it mourn; and it rises like the Nile, all of it, and sinks like the Nile of Egypt;

en.L: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of hosts [is] the one who touches the earth so that it melts, \q and all who live in it mourn, \q and it rises, all of it, like the Nile, \q and sinks like the Nile of Egypt;
en.B: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies touches the earth and it melts, \q and all who live in it mourn; \q all of it rises like the Nile \q and sinks again like the Nile of Egypt.
en.R: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies touches the earth, and it melts, \q and everyone who lives on it mourns. \q The whole earth rises and falls \q like the Nile River in Egypt.

es.L: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos [es] el que toca la tierra y se derrite, \q y hacen duelo todos los que habitan en ella, \q y sube toda ella como el Nilo, \q y baja como el Nilo de Egipto;
es.B: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos toca la tierra y se derrite, \q y todos los que viven en ella hacen duelo; \q toda ella sube como el Nilo \q y vuelve a bajar como el Nilo de Egipto.
es.R: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos toca la tierra, y esta se derrite, \q y todos los que viven en ella hacen duelo. \q Toda la tierra sube y baja \q como el río Nilo en Egipto.

fr.L: Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées [est] celui qui touche la terre et elle fond, \q et tous ceux qui l’habitent sont en deuil, \q et elle monte tout entière comme le Nil, \q et s’affaisse comme le Nil d’Égypte ;
fr.B: Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées touche la terre, et elle fond, \q et tous ceux qui l’habitent prennent le deuil ; \q elle se soulève tout entière comme le Nil \q et retombe comme le Nil d’Égypte.
fr.R: Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées touche la terre, et elle fond, \q et tous ceux qui y vivent sont en deuil. \q La terre entière monte et descend \q comme le Nil en Égypte.

sw.L: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi [ndiye] aigusaye nchi nayo ikayeyuka, \q na wote wakaao ndani yake wakaomboleza, \q nayo ikainuka yote kama Nile, \q na kushuka kama Nile wa Misri;
sw.B: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi huigusa nchi nayo inayeyuka, \q na wote wanaoishi ndani yake wanaomboleza; \q yote inainuka kama Nile \q na kushuka tena kama Nile wa Misri.
sw.R: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi huigusa dunia nayo inayeyuka, \q na kila mtu anayeishi juu yake anaomboleza. \q Dunia yote inainuka na kushuka \q kama mto Nile wa Misri.

ko.L: 만군의 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 땅을 만지시니 땅이 녹고, \q 거기 사는 모든 사람이 슬퍼한다. \q 온 땅이 나일 강처럼 불어 오르고, \q 이집트의 나일 강처럼 가라앉는다.
ko.B: 만군의 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 땅을 만지시면 땅이 녹아내리고 \q 거기 사는 사람들이 모두 슬퍼한다. \q 온 땅이 나일 강처럼 부풀어 오르고 \q 이집트의 나일 강처럼 다시 가라앉는다.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 땅을 만지시면 땅이 녹아내린다. \q 땅에 사는 사람들이 모두 슬퍼한다. \q 온 땅이 이집트의 나일 강처럼 \q 불어 올랐다가 가라앉는다.

vi.L: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân [là] Đấng chạm đến đất thì đất tan chảy, \q và mọi người ở trên đất than khóc, \q và cả đất dâng lên như sông Nin, \q rồi hạ xuống như sông Nin của Ai Cập;
vi.B: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân chạm đến đất thì đất tan chảy, \q và mọi người sống trên đất than khóc; \q cả đất dâng lên như sông Nin \q rồi hạ xuống như sông Nin của Ai Cập.
vi.R: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân chạm đến đất, và đất tan chảy. \q Mọi người sống trên đất đều than khóc. \q Cả đất dâng lên rồi hạ xuống \q như sông Nin ở Ai Cập.

pt.L: O Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} dos Exércitos [é] aquele que toca a terra, e ela se derrete, \q e todos os que nela habitam choram, \q e ela sobe, toda ela, como o Nilo, \q e baixa como o Nilo do Egito;
pt.B: O Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} dos Exércitos toca a terra, e ela se derrete, \q e todos os que nela moram ficam de luto; \q toda ela sobe como o Nilo \q e baixa de novo como o Nilo do Egito.
pt.R: O Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} dos Exércitos toca a terra, e ela se derrete, \q e todos os que moram nela ficam de luto. \q A terra inteira sobe e desce \q como o rio Nilo, no Egito.

am.L: ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት ምድርን የሚነካት፣ እርሷም የምትቀልጥ፣ \q በእርሷም የሚኖሩ ሁሉ የሚያለቅሱባት፣ \q ሁለንተናዋም እንደ ዓባይ የምትነሣ፣ \q እንደ ግብፅም ዓባይ የምትወርድ፤
am.B: ጌታ፣ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ምድርን ይነካል፤ እርሷም ትቀልጣለች፤ \q በእርሷ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ያለቅሳሉ፤ \q ሁለንተናዋ እንደ ዓባይ ወንዝ ትነሣለች፤ \q እንደ ግብፅ ዓባይም እንደ ገና ትወርዳለች።
am.R: ጌታ፣ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ምድርን ሲነካ ትቀልጣለች፤ \q በእርሷ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ያለቅሳሉ። \q ምድሪቱ ሁሉ በግብፅ እንዳለው የዓባይ ወንዝ \q ትነሣለች፤ ትወርዳለችም።

hi.L: प्रभु, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}, [वे हैं] जो पृथ्वी को छूते हैं तो वह पिघल जाती है, \q और उसके सब निवासी शोक करते हैं, \q और वह सारी की सारी नील नदी के समान उठती है, \q और मिस्र की नील नदी के समान बैठ जाती है;
hi.B: प्रभु, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}, पृथ्वी को छूते हैं और वह पिघल जाती है, \q और उसके सब रहनेवाले शोक करते हैं; \q सारी पृथ्वी नील नदी के समान उठती है \q और मिस्र की नील नदी के समान फिर बैठ जाती है।
hi.R: प्रभु, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}, पृथ्वी को छूते हैं, और वह पिघल जाती है, \q और उस पर रहनेवाला हर व्यक्ति शोक करता है। \q सारी पृथ्वी उठती और गिरती है, \q मिस्र की नील नदी के समान।

ru.L: Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф — тот, кто касается земли, и она тает, \q и скорбят все живущие на ней, \q и поднимается она вся, как Нил, \q и опускается, как Нил Египетский;
ru.B: Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф касается земли, и она тает, \q и скорбят все живущие на ней; \q вся она поднимается, как Нил, \q и снова опускается, как Нил Египта.
ru.R: Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств касается земли, и она тает, \q и все, кто живёт на ней, скорбят. \q Вся земля поднимается и опускается, \q как река Нил в Египте.

ja.L: 万軍の{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は、地に触れてそれを溶かされる方。 \q そこに住むすべての者は嘆き、 \q 地はことごとくナイルのように盛り上がり、 \q エジプトのナイルのように沈む。
ja.B: 万軍の{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}が地に触れられると、地は溶け、 \q そこに住む者はみな嘆き悲しむ。 \q 地全体がナイルのように盛り上がり、 \q エジプトのナイルのように再び沈む。
ja.R: 天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}が地に触れられると、地は溶け、 \q そこに住む人々はみな嘆き悲しむ。 \q 地全体が盛り上がったり沈んだりする。 \q エジプトのナイル川のように。

decisions.choice: a hymn to the Lord GOD of hosts, the third in the book
decisions.reason: Verses 5-6 are a hymn like 4:13 and 5:8-9, and they end, as those do, with 'the LORD is his name'. After the vision of verses 1-4, the hymn says who it is that cannot be escaped: the one whose touch makes the earth melt.

decisions.choice: it rises like the Nile ... sinks like the Nile of Egypt: as 8:8
decisions.reason: The second half of the verse repeats 8:8 almost word for word: the earth heaves like the rising and falling Nile. The wording at each level follows 8:8.

decisions.choice: the Lord GOD of hosts (L); the Lord GOD of Armies (B, R)
decisions.reason: Adonai YHWH with 'of hosts' follows the settled wording: 'the Lord GOD' for Adonai with the divine name, and 'hosts' at Literal, 'Armies' at Balanced and Readable, as in 'the LORD of hosts'.

decisions.choice: "el Señor DIOS de los ejércitos" (L); "de los Ejércitos" (B, R); the Nile lines as 8:8
decisions.reason: Adonai YHWH of hosts as the terms note sets; the last two lines repeat the Spanish of 8:8 at each level.

decisions.choice: "le Seigneur DIEU des armées" at every level
decisions.reason: The term sheet's form for Adonai YHWH of hosts, as the French Jeremiah 2:19.

decisions.choice: "Bwana MUNGU wa majeshi" at every level, with the span on MUNGU
decisions.reason: Adonai YHWH of hosts, as the term sheet sets. The Nile lines repeat 8:8 at each level.

decisions.choice: "만군의 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서" with -시- through the hymn of 9:5–6
decisions.reason: The third hymn speaks of God, as 4:13 and 5:8; "the Lord GOD of hosts" is "만군의 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}" (Isaiah note), with the particle 께서 that reads after both forms.

decisions.choice: "Chúa là CHÚA Vạn Quân" at every level; the Nile lines as 8:8
alternatives: "Chúa là CHÚA, Đức Chúa Trời Vạn Quân"
decisions.reason: Adonai YHWH hatseva'ot is "Chúa là CHÚA Vạn Quân", as Isaiah and the terms sheet give it, with the span on CHÚA only.

decisions.choice: o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos (every level); the Portuguese of 8:8
decisions.reason: Adonai YHWH with "of hosts" joins "o Senhor DEUS" and "dos Exércitos" at every level (3:13). The second half repeats 8:8 (m2), and each level keeps 8:8's Portuguese.

decisions.choice: the Lord GOD of hosts (Adonai YHWH ha-tsevaot): "ጌታ [the LORD] ጸባኦት" (L), "ጌታ፣ የሠራዊት አምላክ [the LORD]" (B, R); the Nile lines as 8:8
decisions.reason: YHWH Tsevaot keeps the terms list's forms, with "ጌታ" before them for Adonai. The last two lines repeat 8:8 in the Hebrew and keep its wording.

decisions.choice: प्रभु, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}
decisions.reason: Adonai YHWH of hosts joins the note's form for the Lord GOD to "of hosts": प्रभु (Adonai) first, then the divine name with सेनाओं के, so the setting's alternative reads "प्रभु, सेनाओं के याहवे". The Nile lines keep the wording of 8:8 (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: Владыка ГОСПОДЬ Саваоф (L, B), Воинств (R); the Nile lines as 8:8
decisions.reason: The Lord GOD of hosts in the Prophets' forms; the last lines repeat 8:8 at each level (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: 'adonai YHWH hatseva'ot "万軍の主なる神" (L, B), "天の軍勢を率いる主なる神" (R) in the span {{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}, as ISA 10:16; the Nile lines worded as 8:8.
decisions.reason: The ISA formula table; one wording for the repeated lines.

source.text: הַבּוֹנֶ֤ה בַשָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ מַעֲלוֹתָ֔יו וַאֲגֻדָּת֖וֹ עַל־אֶ֣רֶץ יְסָדָ֑הּ הַקֹּרֵ֣א לְמֵֽי־הַיָּ֗ם וַֽיִּשְׁפְּכֵ֛ם עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ יְהוָ֥ה שְׁמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: who builds in the heavens his upper chambers, and his vault on [the] earth he has founded it; who calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out on [the] face of the earth, Yahweh [is] his name.

en.L: who builds {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} upper chambers in the heavens \q and has founded {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} vault upon the earth, \q who calls the waters of the sea and pours them out on the face of the earth, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.
en.B: He builds {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} upper chambers in the heavens \q and sets {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} vault firmly over the earth. \q He calls up the waters of the sea and pours them out across the face of the earth: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.
en.R: He builds {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} palace high in the heavens \q and sets the dome of the sky over the earth. \q He calls for the water of the sea and pours it out on the land. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.

es.L: el que edifica en los cielos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} aposentos altos \q y ha fundado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} bóveda sobre la tierra, \q el que llama a las aguas del mar y las derrama sobre la faz de la tierra, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.B: Él edifica en los cielos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} aposentos altos \q y asienta {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} bóveda sobre la tierra. \q Él llama a las aguas del mar y las derrama sobre la faz de la tierra: {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.R: Él construye {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palacio en lo alto de los cielos \q y pone la cúpula del cielo sobre la tierra. \q Llama a las aguas del mar y las derrama sobre la tierra. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.

fr.L: {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui bâtit dans les cieux {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} chambres hautes \q et qui a fondé {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voûte sur la terre, \q qui appelle les eaux de la mer et les répand sur la face de la terre, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.
fr.B: Il bâtit dans les cieux {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} chambres hautes \q et pose solidement {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voûte au-dessus de la terre. \q Il appelle les eaux de la mer et les répand sur la face de la terre : {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.
fr.R: Il bâtit {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} palais tout en haut des cieux \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} place le dôme du ciel au-dessus de la terre. \q Il appelle l’eau de la mer et la verse sur la terre. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.

sw.L: ajengaye vyumba {{deity_pronoun:vyake|Vyake}} vya juu mbinguni \q na kuiweka kuba {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} juu ya nchi, \q ayaitaye maji ya bahari na kuyamwaga juu ya uso wa nchi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ndilo] jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.B: Hujenga vyumba {{deity_pronoun:vyake|Vyake}} vya juu mbinguni \q na kuiweka kuba {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} imara juu ya dunia. \q Huyaita maji ya bahari na kuyamwaga juu ya uso wa nchi: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndilo jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.R: Hujenga jumba {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} la kifalme juu mbinguni \q na kuiweka kuba ya anga juu ya dunia. \q Huyaita maji ya bahari na kuyamwaga juu ya nchi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndilo jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.

ko.L: 하늘에 그분의 다락방들을 지으시고 \q 땅 위에 그분의 궁창의 기초를 놓으신 분, \q 바닷물을 불러 땅 위에 쏟으시는 분, 그분의 이름은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다.
ko.B: 그분은 하늘에 그분의 높은 누각을 지으시고 \q 땅 위에 둥근 천장을 든든히 세우신다. \q 바닷물을 불러 올려 온 땅 위에 쏟으신다. 그분의 이름은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다.
ko.R: 그분은 하늘 높은 곳에 그분의 궁전을 지으시고 \q 땅 위에 둥근 하늘을 덮으신다. \q 바닷물을 불러 올려 땅 위에 쏟으신다. 그분의 이름은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다.

vi.L: là Đấng xây các phòng cao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên các tầng trời \q và đã đặt nền vòm trời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên đất, \q Đấng gọi nước biển và đổ chúng ra trên mặt đất, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ngài xây các phòng cao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên các tầng trời \q và đặt vững vòm trời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên đất. \q Ngài gọi nước biển lên và đổ ra khắp mặt đất: danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Ngài xây cung điện của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên trời cao \q và đặt vòm trời trên mặt đất. \q Ngài gọi nước biển lên và đổ ra trên đất liền. Danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

pt.L: que constrói nos céus os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} aposentos altos \q e firmou a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} abóbada sobre a terra, \q que chama as águas do mar e as derrama sobre a face da terra: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} [é] o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome.
pt.B: Ele constrói os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} aposentos altos nos céus \q e firma a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} abóbada sobre a terra. \q Ele chama as águas do mar e as derrama sobre a face da terra: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome.
pt.R: Ele constrói o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} palácio no alto dos céus \q e firma a cúpula do céu sobre a terra. \q Ele chama as águas do mar e as derrama sobre a terra. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome.

am.L: በሰማያት ሰገነቱን የሚሠራ፣ \q ጠፈሩንም በምድር ላይ የመሠረተ፣ \q የባሕርን ውኆች የሚጠራ፣ በምድርም ፊት ላይ የሚያፈሳቸው፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ስሙ [ነው]።
am.B: በሰማያት ሰገነቱን ይሠራል፤ \q ጠፈሩንም በምድር ላይ ያጸናል። \q የባሕርን ውኆች ጠርቶ በምድር ፊት ሁሉ ላይ ያፈሳቸዋል፤ ስሙ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው።
am.R: በሰማይ ከፍ ብሎ ቤተ መንግሥቱን ይሠራል፤ \q የሰማይንም ጉልላት በምድር ላይ ይዘረጋል። \q የባሕርን ውኃ ጠርቶ በምድር ላይ ያፈሰዋል። ስሙ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው።

hi.L: जो आकाश में अपनी अटारियाँ बनाते \q और पृथ्वी के ऊपर अपने गुंबद की नींव डाल चुके हैं, \q जो समुद्र के जल को बुलाते और उसे पृथ्वी के तल पर उँडेल देते हैं, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनका नाम [है]।
hi.B: वे आकाश में अपनी अटारियाँ बनाते हैं \q और पृथ्वी के ऊपर अपने गुंबद को दृढ़ता से स्थिर करते हैं। \q वे समुद्र के जल को बुलाकर पृथ्वी पर उँडेल देते हैं: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनका नाम है।
hi.R: वे आकाश में ऊँचे पर अपना महल बनाते हैं \q और धरती के ऊपर आकाश का गुंबद तानते हैं। \q वे समुद्र का पानी बुलाकर उसे धरती पर उँडेल देते हैं। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनका नाम है।

ru.L: кто строит на небесах свои горницы \q и свод свой утвердил над землёй, \q кто призывает воды моря и изливает их на лицо земли, — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} имя {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Он строит на небесах свои горницы \q и прочно утверждает свой свод над землёй. \q Он призывает воды моря и изливает их по лицу земли: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя.
ru.R: Он строит свой дворец высоко на небесах \q и ставит над землёй небесный свод. \q Он призывает воду из моря и выливает её на землю. Имя {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: 天にご自分の高殿を建て、 \q 地の上にご自分の丸天井を据え、 \q 海の水を呼び寄せて地の面に注がれる方、その名は{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}。
ja.B: その方は天に高殿を建て、 \q 地の上に大空を堅く据えられる。 \q 海の水を呼び集めて、地の面に注がれる。その名は{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}。
ja.R: その方は、天の高い所にご自分の宮殿を建て、 \q 地の上に、丸い天井のような空を据えられる。 \q 海の水を呼び集めて、陸地に注がれる。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、その方の名だ。

decisions.choice: upper chambers ... vault: God's dwelling above, and the dome of the sky over the earth
alternatives: his steps (a stairway) in the heavens
decisions.reason: Ma'alot here seems to mean upper rooms or steps, a picture of God's dwelling built high above the heavens (compare Psalm 104:3, 13). 'Aguddah is usually a bundle or band; here it seems to be the arch of the sky, set firmly over the earth like a vault resting on its foundations. The words are rare, and the exact picture is uncertain.
