records.literal_gloss: [Are] not like [the] sons of [the] Cushites you to me, sons of Israel? declares Yahweh. Did I not bring up Israel from [the] land of Egypt, and [the] Philistines from Caphtor, and Aram from Kir?

en.L: Are you not like the {{gender:children|sons}} of the Cushites to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel? declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q Did I not bring up Israel from the land of Egypt, \q and the Philistines from Caphtor, and Aram from Kir?
en.B: Are you not like the Cushites to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, people of Israel? declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q Did I not bring Israel up out of Egypt, \q and the Philistines from Caphtor and the Arameans from Kir?
en.R: People of Israel, to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} you are no different from the people of Cush, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q I brought Israel out of Egypt, \q but I also brought the Philistines from Crete and the Arameans from Kir.

es.L: ¿No {{plural_you:son|sois}} {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} como los hijos de los cusitas, hijos de Israel?, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q ¿No hice yo subir a Israel de la tierra de Egipto, \q y a los filisteos de Caftor, y a Aram de Quir?
es.B: ¿No {{plural_you:son|sois}} {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} como los cusitas, israelitas?, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q ¿No saqué yo a Israel de Egipto, \q y a los filisteos de Caftor y a los arameos de Quir?
es.R: Pueblo de Israel, para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} no {{plural_you:son|sois}} diferentes de la gente de Cus, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Yo saqué a Israel de Egipto, \q pero también traje a los filisteos de Creta y a los arameos de Quir.

fr.L: N’êtes-vous pas pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} comme les {{gender:enfants|fils}} des Koushites, {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël ? déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q N’ai-je pas fait monter Israël du pays d’Égypte, \q et les Philistins de Caphtor, et Aram de Qir ?
fr.B: N’êtes-vous pas pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} comme les Koushites, {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ? déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q N’ai-je pas fait monter Israël d’Égypte, \q et les Philistins de Caphtor, et les Araméens de Qir ?
fr.R: {{gender:Israélites|Fils d’Israël}}, pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, vous n’êtes pas différents des gens de Koush, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q J’ai fait sortir Israël d’Égypte, \q mais j’ai aussi amené les Philistins de Crète et les Araméens de Qir.

sw.L: Je, ninyi si kama wana wa Wakushi {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}, enyi wana wa Israeli? asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Je, sikuwapandisha Israeli kutoka nchi ya Misri, \q na Wafilisti kutoka Kaftori, na Aramu kutoka Kiri?
sw.B: Je, ninyi si kama Wakushi {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}, enyi watu wa Israeli? asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Je, sikuwapandisha Israeli kutoka Misri, \q na Wafilisti kutoka Kaftori, na Waaramu kutoka Kiri?
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Israeli, {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}} ninyi si tofauti na watu wa Kushi, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Niliwatoa Israeli Misri, \q lakini pia niliwaleta Wafilisti kutoka Krete na Waaramu kutoka Kiri.

ko.L: {{gender:이스라엘 자손|이스라엘의 아들들}}아, 너희는 나에게 {{gender:구스 자손|구스의 아들들}}과 같지 않으냐? {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. \q 내가 이스라엘을 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 올리지 않았느냐? \q 블레셋 사람들을 갑돌에서, 아람 사람들을 기르에서 [이끌어 올리지 않았느냐]?
ko.B: 이스라엘 백성아, 너희는 나에게 구스 사람들과 같지 않으냐? {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 내가 이스라엘을 이집트에서 이끌어 올리지 않았느냐? \q 블레셋 사람들을 갑돌에서, 아람 사람들을 기르에서 이끌어 올리지 않았느냐?
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성아, 나에게는 너희가 구스 사람들과 다를 것이 없다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 내가 이스라엘을 이집트에서 데리고 나왔다. \q 그러나 블레셋 사람들도 그레데에서, 아람 사람들도 기르에서 데리고 나왔다.

vi.L: Hỡi con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên, chẳng phải các ngươi đối với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng như con cái người Cút sao? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. \q Chẳng phải {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đem Y-sơ-ra-ên lên khỏi đất Ai Cập, \q và người Phi-li-tin từ Cáp-tô, và A-ram từ Ki-rơ sao?
vi.B: Hỡi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, chẳng phải các ngươi đối với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng như người Cút sao? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. \q Chẳng phải {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đem Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi Ai Cập, \q đem người Phi-li-tin từ Cáp-tô và người A-ram từ Ki-rơ sao?
vi.R: Hỡi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, đối với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, các ngươi chẳng khác gì dân Cút, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. \q Ta đã đem Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi Ai Cập, \q nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng đã đem người Phi-li-tin từ đảo Cơ-rết và người A-ram từ Ki-rơ.

pt.L: Não são vocês para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} como os filhos dos cuxitas, filhos de Israel? declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. \q Não fiz eu subir Israel da terra do Egito, \q e os filisteus de Caftor, e Arã de Quir?
pt.B: Não são vocês para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} como os cuxitas, israelitas? declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. \q Não tirei eu Israel do Egito, \q e os filisteus de Caftor, e os arameus de Quir?
pt.R: Povo de Israel, para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} vocês não são diferentes do povo de Cuxe, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. \q Eu tirei Israel do Egito, \q mas também trouxe os filisteus de Creta e os arameus de Quir.

am.L: የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፣ እናንተ ለእኔ እንደ ኩሻውያን ልጆች አይደላችሁምን? ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። \q እስራኤልን ከግብፅ ምድር፣ \q ፍልስጥኤማውያንንም ከከፍቶር፣ አራምንም ከቂር አላወጣሁምን?
am.B: የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፣ ለእኔ እንደ ኩሻውያን አይደላችሁምን? ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። \q እስራኤልን ከግብፅ ምድር፣ \q ፍልስጥኤማውያንን ከከፍቶር፣ አራማውያንንም ከቂር አላወጣሁምን?
am.R: የእስራኤል ሕዝብ ሆይ፣ ለእኔ ከኩሽ ሕዝብ ምንም አትለዩም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። \q እስራኤልን ከግብፅ አወጣሁ፤ \q ፍልስጥኤማውያንንም ከቀርጤስ፣ አራማውያንንም ከቂር አመጣሁ።

hi.L: हे {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रो}}, क्या तुम मेरे लिए {{gender:कूशियों की सन्तान|कूशियों के पुत्रों}} के समान नहीं हो? {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है। \q क्या मैं इस्राएल को मिस्र देश से, \q और पलिश्तियों को कप्तोर से, और अराम को कीर से नहीं निकाल लाया?
hi.B: हे इस्राएल के लोगो, क्या तुम मेरे लिए कूशियों के समान नहीं हो? {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है। \q क्या मैं इस्राएल को मिस्र से नहीं निकाल लाया, \q और पलिश्तियों को कप्तोर से और अरामियों को कीर से?
hi.R: हे इस्राएल के लोगो, मेरे लिए तुम कूश के लोगों से अलग नहीं हो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। \q मैं इस्राएल को मिस्र से निकाल लाया, \q पर पलिश्तियों को क्रेते से और अरामियों को कीर से भी मैं ही लाया।

ru.L: Не как {{gender:дети кушитов|сыны кушитов}} ли вы для {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, {{gender:дети Израиля|сыны Израиля}}? — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. \q Не {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ли вывел Израиль из земли Египта, \q и филистимлян — из Кафтора, и Арам — из Кира?
ru.B: Разве вы для {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} не то же, что кушиты, израильтяне? — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. \q Разве не {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вывел Израиль из Египта, \q а филистимлян — из Кафтора и арамеев — из Кира?
ru.R: Народ Израиля, для {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} вы ничем не отличаетесь от жителей Куша, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. \q Я вывел Израиль из Египта, \q но {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} также привёл филистимлян с Крита и арамеев из Кира.

ja.L: イスラエルの子らよ、あなたがたはわたしにとって、クシュ人の子らのようではないか？――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉―― \q わたしはイスラエルをエジプトの地から導き上り、 \q ペリシテ人をカフトルから、アラムをキルから[導き上った]ではないか？
ja.B: イスラエルの人々よ、あなたがたはわたしにとって、クシュ人と変わらないではないか、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。 \q わたしはイスラエルをエジプトから導き上り、 \q ペリシテ人をカフトルから、アラム人をキルから導き上ったではないか？
ja.R: イスラエルの人々よ、わたしにとって、あなたたちはクシュの人々と何も変わらない、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。 \q わたしはイスラエルをエジプトから連れ出した。 \q しかし、ペリシテ人をクレタから、アラム人をキルから連れ出したのも、わたしだ。

decisions.choice: the Cushites: the people of the upper Nile, south of Egypt
decisions.reason: Cush was the land along the Nile south of Egypt, roughly the north of modern Sudan. To Israel it was a land at the far edge of the known world (Isaiah 18:1-2). The LORD says that Israel is no more privileged before him than that distant people.

decisions.choice: the Philistines from Caphtor, Aram from Kir: other peoples whose migrations the LORD guided
decisions.reason: The Philistines came from Caphtor, usually identified with Crete (Deuteronomy 2:23; Jeremiah 47:4). Kir was the place the Arameans came from, and to which Amos said they would return (1:5; 2 Kings 16:9). The LORD led these peoples too. The exodus did not make Israel his favorite, safe whatever it did; it made Israel answerable to him (3:2).

decisions.choice: the Cushites; people of Israel (B); no different from the people of Cush; Crete (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say 'people of Israel' for 'sons of Israel', and Literal uses the gender setting. Readable turns the questions into the statements they expect, and says 'Crete' for Caphtor, as Jeremiah 47:4 does at Readable (m2).

decisions.choice: "los hijos de los cusitas, hijos de Israel", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" already includes the whole people, so the English gender spans have no Spanish counterpart; Caftor and Quir as Deuteronomy 2:23 and 2 Kings 16:9 in Spanish, with Creta at R as the English R.

decisions.choice: "구스" for Cush; "갑돌" (L, B) and "그레데" (R) for Caphtor; L has gender spans on both "sons of" phrases
decisions.reason: The published spellings (Deuteronomy 2:23 갑돌; Acts 2:11 그레데). The English Readable says Crete, and the Korean Readable uses the New Testament name.

decisions.choice: "Hỡi con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên" (L) / "Hỡi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên" (B, R) placed first, with no gender span
alternatives: the address at the end of the question
decisions.reason: Vietnamese puts the address first; "con cái" and "dân" already include men and women, so the English gender alternative is not needed.

decisions.choice: os filhos dos cuxitas, filhos de Israel (L), with no gender setting; Caftor (L, B), Creta (R)
decisions.reason: As at 2:11, "filhos" already includes daughters, so the English gender spans have no second Portuguese wording. Caphtor keeps the form Jeremiah 47:4 gives it in Portuguese, and Readable says "Creta", as Jeremiah's Readable does; Cush is "Cuxe", its people "cuxitas".

decisions.choice: the Cushites "ኩሻውያን" (L, B), as 2 Chronicles 14:11, "የኩሽ ሕዝብ" (R), not "ኢትዮጵያውያን"; Caphtor "ከፍቶር" (Deuteronomy 2:23), Readable "ቀርጤስ" (Crete) as the English
decisions.reason: The meaning decision places Cush on the upper Nile south of Egypt, and the terms lists keep "ኩሽ" for the Hebrew name, so the verse does not read as a statement about the modern country; familiar Amharic Bibles say "ኢትዮጵያውያን" here, and a reviewer may want a footnote saying so. The point, that the LORD guided distant peoples too, is the same either way.

decisions.choice: कूशी; कप्तोर (L, B), क्रेते (R); कीर
decisions.reason: The Cushites, Caphtor and Kir keep the forms of Chronicles, Deuteronomy 2:23 and 1:5; Readable names Caphtor as Crete in the New Testament's form, as the English Readable does. Literal carries the gender setting on both "sons of" phrases, as the English does.

decisions.choice: кушиты, Куш; Кафтор (L, B), Крит (R); Кир
decisions.reason: The people of the upper Nile (meaning decision), named Cushites as Samuel and Chronicles do, since "эфиопы" now names a modern nation; Caphtor as Deuteronomy, Crete at Readable as the English.

decisions.choice: {{gender:дети кушитов|сыны кушитов}}; {{gender:дети Израиля|сыны Израиля}}
decisions.reason: As the English Literal's gender spans.

decisions.choice: bene Kushiyyim "クシュ人の子ら" (L), "クシュ人" (B), "クシュの人々" (R), and bene Yisra'el "イスラエルの子ら / 人々", with no gender spans where the English L has them; Caphtor "カフトル" (L, B), "クレタ" (R, as the English R); Kir "キル" (1:5).
decisions.reason: 子ら and 人々 are already inclusive; the place names as the OT notes (Caphtor カフトル, GEN 10).

source.text: הִנֵּ֞ה עֵינֵ֣י׀אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה בַּמַּמְלָכָה֙ הַֽחַטָּאָ֔ה וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔הּ מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה אֶ֗פֶס כִּ֠י לֹ֣א הַשְׁמֵ֥יד אַשְׁמִ֛יד אֶת־בֵּ֥ית יַעֲקֹ֖ב נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, the eyes of [the] Lord Yahweh [are] on the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from on [the] face of the ground; except that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, declares Yahweh.

en.L: Look, the eyes of the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} [are] on the kingdom that sins, \q and I will wipe it out \q from upon the face of the ground; \q except that I will not utterly wipe out the house of Jacob, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Look, the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}'s eyes are on the sinful kingdom, \q and I will wipe it off the face of the earth. \q Yet I will not destroy the house of Jacob completely, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} is watching this sinful kingdom, \q and I will wipe it off the face of the earth. \q But I will not destroy all of Jacob's people, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: He aquí, los ojos del Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} [están] sobre el reino pecador, \q y lo destruiré \q de sobre la faz de la tierra; \q pero no destruiré del todo la casa de Jacob, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Los ojos del Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} están sobre el reino pecador, \q y lo borraré de la faz de la tierra. \q Pero no destruiré por completo a la casa de Jacob, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} está vigilando este reino pecador, \q y lo borraré de la faz de la tierra. \q Pero no destruiré a todo el pueblo de Jacob, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Voici, les yeux du Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} [sont] sur le royaume qui pèche, \q et je l’exterminerai \q de la face du sol ; \q seulement, je n’exterminerai pas entièrement la maison de Jacob, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Les yeux du Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} sont fixés sur le royaume pécheur, \q et je l’effacerai de la surface de la terre. \q Pourtant je ne détruirai pas complètement la maison de Jacob, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} surveille ce royaume pécheur, \q et je l’effacerai de la surface de la terre. \q Mais je ne détruirai pas tout le peuple de Jacob, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Tazama, macho ya Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} [yako] juu ya ufalme utendao dhambi, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitauangamiza \q kutoka juu ya uso wa ardhi; \q isipokuwa sitaiangamiza kabisa nyumba ya Yakobo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Tazama, macho ya Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} yako juu ya ufalme wenye dhambi, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaufutilia mbali kutoka uso wa dunia. \q Lakini sitaiangamiza kabisa nyumba ya Yakobo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} anautazama ufalme huu wenye dhambi, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaufutilia mbali kutoka uso wa dunia. \q Lakini sitawaangamiza wazao wote wa Yakobo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

ko.L: 보라, 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 눈이 죄를 짓는 나라 위에 있다. \q 내가 그 나라를 \q 땅 위에서 없애 버리겠다. \q 그러나 야곱의 집은 완전히 없애지는 않겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 보아라, 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 눈이 이 죄 많은 나라를 지켜보고 있다. \q 내가 그 나라를 땅 위에서 쓸어버리겠다. \q 그러나 야곱의 집을 완전히 멸하지는 않겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 눈이 이 죄 많은 나라를 지켜보고 있다. \q 나는 그 나라를 땅 위에서 쓸어버리겠다. \q 그러나 야곱의 자손을 모두 멸하지는 않겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

vi.L: Này, mắt của Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [ở] trên vương quốc phạm tội, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hủy diệt nó \q khỏi mặt đất; \q chỉ có điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không hủy diệt hoàn toàn nhà Gia-cốp, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Này, mắt của Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang nhìn vương quốc tội lỗi này, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ quét sạch nó khỏi mặt đất. \q Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không hủy diệt nhà Gia-cốp hoàn toàn, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang theo dõi vương quốc tội lỗi này, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ quét sạch nó khỏi mặt đất. \q Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không hủy diệt hết dân Gia-cốp, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

pt.L: Eis que os olhos do Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} [estão] sobre o reino pecador, \q e eu o eliminarei \q de sobre a face da terra; \q exceto que não eliminarei totalmente a casa de Jacó, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Vejam, os olhos do Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} estão sobre o reino pecador, \q e eu o varrerei da face da terra. \q Mas não destruirei completamente a casa de Jacó, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: O Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} está de olho neste reino pecador, \q e eu vou varrê-lo da face da terra. \q Mas não vou destruir todo o povo de Jacó, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: እነሆ፣ የጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ዓይኖች ኃጢአት በምትሠራው መንግሥት ላይ ናቸው፤ \q እደመስሳታለሁም \q ከምድር ፊት ላይ፤ \q ነገር ግን የያዕቆብን ቤት ፈጽሞ አልደመስስም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.B: የጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ዓይኖች በኃጢአተኛይቱ መንግሥት ላይ ናቸው፤ \q ከምድር ፊት ላይ እደመስሳታለሁ። \q ነገር ግን የያዕቆብን ቤት ፈጽሞ አላጠፋም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይህችን ኃጢአተኛ መንግሥት ይመለከታል፤ \q እኔም ከምድር ፊት ላይ እደመስሳታለሁ። \q ነገር ግን የያዕቆብን ዘሮች ሁሉ አላጠፋም፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: देखो, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की आँखें पाप करनेवाले राज्य पर [लगी हैं], \q और मैं उसे मिटा दूँगा \q भूमि के तल पर से; \q तौभी मैं याकूब के घराने को पूरी तरह न मिटाऊँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.B: देखो, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की आँखें इस पापी राज्य पर लगी हैं, \q और मैं उसे पृथ्वी के तल पर से मिटा दूँगा। \q फिर भी मैं याकूब के घराने को पूरी तरह नष्ट नहीं करूँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.R: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} इस पापी राज्य को देख रहे हैं, \q और मैं उसे धरती पर से मिटा दूँगा। \q पर मैं याकूब के सब वंशजों को नष्ट नहीं करूँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: Вот, глаза Владыки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} — на грешном царстве, \q и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} истреблю его \q с лица земли; \q только не истреблю совсем дома Иакова, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Вот, глаза Владыки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} обращены на грешное царство, \q и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сотру его с лица земли. \q Но дом Иакова {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не истреблю совсем, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} следит за этим грешным царством, \q и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сотру его с лица земли. \q Но {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не истреблю всех потомков Иакова, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: 見なさい、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}の目は罪を犯す王国に[向けられている]。 \q わたしはそれを \q 地の面から根絶やしにする。 \q ただし、ヤコブの家を全く根絶やしにはしない。――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――
ja.B: 見なさい、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}の目は罪深い王国に注がれている。 \q わたしはそれを地の面から消し去る。 \q しかし、ヤコブの家を滅ぼし尽くすことはしない、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は、この罪深い王国を見張っている。 \q わたしはそれを地の上から消し去る。 \q しかし、ヤコブの子孫をすべて滅ぼすことはしない、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。

decisions.choice: the sinful kingdom: Israel itself, though the words state a rule for every kingdom
decisions.reason: After 'my eyes on them for harm' (verse 4), the kingdom is most likely the northern kingdom. The phrase also states a rule: the LORD watches every sinful kingdom, Israel no less than others (verse 7).

decisions.choice: except that I will not utterly destroy: a remnant will survive
decisions.reason: After the sentence on 'the sinful kingdom', the LORD sets a limit: the house of Jacob will not be wiped out completely. The kingdom, the state, will fall, but the people will survive as a remnant (5:15). The sifting of verses 9-10 explains it: the sinners die, but not all are lost, and verses 11-15 go on to the promise.

decisions.choice: is watching (R); all of Jacob's people (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says 'is watching' for 'the eyes ... are on', and 'Jacob's people' for 'the house of Jacob'.

decisions.choice: "主なる神の目" / "主なる神は…見張っている" with no respect form, since God himself is speaking ("わたしは…消し去る").
decisions.reason: As Isaiah 8:7: God naming himself in the third person takes no respect form.

source.text: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֤ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ מְצַוֶּ֔ה וַהֲנִע֥וֹתִי בְכָֽל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר יִנּ֨וֹעַ֙ בַּכְּבָרָ֔ה וְלֹֽא־יִפּ֥וֹל צְר֖וֹר אָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: For look, I [am] commanding, and I will shake among all the nations the house of Israel, as [grain] is shaken in a sieve, and not a pebble will fall [to the] ground.

en.L: For look, I am commanding, \q and I will shake among all the nations the house of Israel, \q as [grain] is shaken in a sieve, \q but not a pebble will fall to the ground.
en.B: For look, I am about to give the command: \q I will shake the house of Israel among all the nations \q the way grain is shaken in a sieve, \q and not a pebble will fall to the ground.
en.R: I will give the command, \q and I will shake the people of Israel among all the nations, \q the way a farmer shakes grain in a sieve. \q Not one pebble will slip through to the ground.

es.L: Porque he aquí, yo daré la orden, \q y zarandearé a la casa de Israel entre todas las naciones, \q como se zarandea [el grano] en la criba, \q y no caerá a tierra ni una piedrecita.
es.B: Porque voy a dar la orden: \q zarandearé a la casa de Israel entre todas las naciones, \q como se zarandea el grano en la criba, \q y no caerá al suelo ni una piedrecita.
es.R: Daré la orden, \q y sacudiré al pueblo de Israel entre todas las naciones, \q como un campesino sacude el grano en una criba. \q Ni una piedrecita se colará hasta el suelo.

fr.L: Car voici, je donne l’ordre, \q et je secouerai parmi toutes les nations la maison d’Israël, \q comme on secoue [le grain] dans un crible, \q et pas un caillou ne tombera à terre.
fr.B: Car je vais donner l’ordre : \q je secouerai la maison d’Israël parmi toutes les nations, \q comme on secoue le grain dans un crible, \q et pas un caillou ne tombera à terre.
fr.R: Je vais donner l’ordre, \q et je secouerai le peuple d’Israël parmi toutes les nations, \q comme un paysan secoue le grain dans un crible. \q Pas un seul caillou ne passera à travers jusqu’au sol.

sw.L: Kwa maana tazama, ninaamuru, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaipepeta nyumba ya Israeli kati ya mataifa yote, \q kama [nafaka] ipepetwavyo katika ungo, \q lakini hakuna kijiwe kitakachoanguka chini.
sw.B: Kwa maana tazama, ninakaribia kutoa amri: \q nitaipepeta nyumba ya Israeli kati ya mataifa yote \q kama nafaka inavyopepetwa katika ungo, \q wala hakuna kijiwe kitakachoanguka chini.
sw.R: Nitatoa amri, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawatikisa watu wa Israeli kati ya mataifa yote, \q kama mkulima anavyotikisa nafaka katika ungo. \q Hakuna kijiwe hata kimoja kitakachopenya hadi chini.

ko.L: 보라, 내가 명령하여 \q 이스라엘 집을 모든 민족 가운데서 흔들겠다. \q 체로 [곡식을] 흔들듯이 [흔들겠지만], \q 돌멩이 하나도 땅에 떨어지지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 보아라, 내가 명령을 내려 \q 이스라엘 집을 모든 민족 가운데서 흔들겠다. \q 곡식을 체로 흔들듯이 흔들겠지만, \q 돌멩이 하나도 땅에 떨어지지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 명령을 내리겠다. \q 나는 이스라엘 백성을 모든 민족 가운데서 흔들겠다. \q 농부가 체로 곡식을 흔들듯이 흔들겠다. \q 돌멩이 하나도 체를 빠져나가 땅에 떨어지지 않을 것이다.

vi.L: Vì này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang truyền lệnh, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sàng nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên giữa mọi dân tộc, \q như [lúa] được sàng trong cái sàng, \q mà không một viên sỏi nào rơi xuống đất.
vi.B: Vì này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp truyền lệnh: \q Ta sẽ sàng nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên giữa mọi dân tộc \q như người ta sàng lúa trong cái sàng, \q và không một viên sỏi nào rơi xuống đất.
vi.R: Ta sẽ truyền lệnh, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sàng dân Y-sơ-ra-ên giữa mọi dân tộc, \q như người nông dân sàng lúa trong cái sàng. \q Không một viên sỏi nào lọt xuống đất.

pt.L: Pois eis que eu dou a ordem, \q e sacudirei entre todas as nações a casa de Israel, \q como se sacode [o grão] numa peneira, \q e nem uma pedrinha cairá no chão.
pt.B: Pois vejam, vou dar a ordem: \q sacudirei a casa de Israel entre todas as nações, \q como se sacode o grão numa peneira, \q e nem uma pedrinha cairá no chão.
pt.R: Vou dar a ordem, \q e vou sacudir o povo de Israel entre todas as nações, \q como o lavrador sacode o grão numa peneira. \q Nem uma pedrinha vai passar e cair no chão.

am.L: እነሆ፣ እኔ አዝዛለሁና፤ \q የእስራኤልንም ቤት በሕዝቦች ሁሉ መካከል አበጥራለሁ፤ \q [እህል] በወንፊት እንደሚበጠር፤ \q ነገር ግን አንዲት ጠጠር በምድር ላይ አትወድቅም።
am.B: ትእዛዝ ልሰጥ ነውና፤ \q የእስራኤልን ቤት በሕዝቦች ሁሉ መካከል አበጥራለሁ፤ \q እህል በወንፊት እንደሚበጠር፤ \q አንዲት ጠጠርም በምድር ላይ አትወድቅም።
am.R: ትእዛዝ እሰጣለሁ፤ \q የእስራኤልንም ሕዝብ በሕዝቦች ሁሉ መካከል አበጥራለሁ፤ \q ገበሬ እህልን በወንፊት እንደሚያበጥር። \q አንዲት ጠጠር እንኳ ሾልካ በምድር ላይ አትወድቅም።

hi.L: क्योंकि देखो, मैं आज्ञा दे रहा हूँ, \q और मैं सब जातियों के बीच इस्राएल के घराने को ऐसे हिलाऊँगा, \q जैसे [अनाज] छलनी में हिलाया जाता है, \q पर एक कंकड़ भी भूमि पर न गिरेगा।
hi.B: क्योंकि देखो, मैं आज्ञा देनेवाला हूँ: \q मैं सब देशों के बीच इस्राएल के घराने को हिलाऊँगा, \q जैसे अनाज छलनी में हिलाया जाता है, \q और एक कंकड़ भी भूमि पर न गिरेगा।
hi.R: मैं आज्ञा दूँगा, \q और इस्राएल के लोगों को सब देशों के बीच हिलाऊँगा, \q जैसे किसान छलनी में अनाज हिलाता है। \q एक कंकड़ भी छनकर ज़मीन पर नहीं गिरेगा।

ru.L: Ведь вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} повелеваю, \q и потрясу среди всех народов дом Израиля, \q как трясут [зерно] в решете, \q но не упадёт ни камешка на землю.
ru.B: Ведь вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отдам повеление: \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} просею дом Израиля среди всех народов, \q как просеивают зерно в решете, \q и ни один камешек не упадёт на землю.
ru.R: Я отдам приказ, \q и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду трясти народ Израиля среди всех народов, \q как земледелец трясёт зерно в решете. \q Ни один камешек не проскочит на землю.

ja.L: まことに、見なさい、わたしは命じる。 \q わたしはすべての国々の間でイスラエルの家を揺さぶる。 \q ふるいで[穀物が]揺さぶられるように。 \q しかし、小石一つ地に落ちることはない。
ja.B: 見なさい、わたしは命令を下す。 \q わたしはイスラエルの家を、すべての国々の間で揺さぶる。 \q 穀物がふるいで揺さぶられるように。 \q しかし、小石一つも地に落ちることはない。
ja.R: わたしは命令を下す。 \q わたしはイスラエルの人々を、すべての国々の間で揺さぶる。 \q 農夫がふるいで穀物を揺さぶるように。 \q 小石一つも、すり抜けて地に落ちることはない。

decisions.choice: a sieve ... not a pebble will fall: the sieve keeps back what must be removed
alternatives: not a kernel will fall to the ground: none of the good grain will be lost
decisions.reason: Kevarah is a sieve. A farmer shook grain in a coarse sieve so that the grain fell through and stones and clods stayed in it to be thrown away. Tseror usually means a pebble (2 Samuel 17:13), and then the point is that no sinner will slip through (verse 10). If the word means a kernel, the sieve keeps the grain, and the point is that not one of the faithful will be lost. Either way, the shaking among the nations sorts the people.

decisions.choice: shake among all the nations: scatter in exile
decisions.reason: The shaking is the scattering of Israel among the nations in exile (9:4).

decisions.choice: grain (L in brackets, B); the way a farmer shakes grain (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only 'as it is shaken in a sieve'; the levels name what is shaken. Readable says 'slip through' to make the picture plain (m1).

decisions.choice: sieve "ወንፊት", shake "አበጠረ", as Isaiah 30:28; the nations (goyim) "ሕዝቦች"
decisions.reason: The sifting keeps Isaiah's words. The nations are "ሕዝቦች" as the terms list has them; only in 9:12, which Acts 15:17 quotes, are they "አሕዛብ".

decisions.choice: tseror "小石" (every level), kevarah "ふるい".
alternatives: "粒" (the other reading: not a grain is lost)
decisions.reason: The English reads pebble, the sieve holding back what must be removed (m1, uncertain and footnoted).

source.text: בַּחֶ֣רֶב יָמ֔וּתוּ כֹּ֖ל חַטָּאֵ֣י עַמִּ֑י הָאֹמְרִ֗ים לֹֽא־תַגִּ֧ישׁ וְתַקְדִּ֛ים בַּעֲדֵ֖ינוּ הָרָעָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: By the sword will die all [the] sinners of my people who say, Not will come near or meet us the disaster.

en.L: By the sword all the sinners of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people will die, \q who say, "Disaster will not come near or confront us."
en.B: All the sinners among {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people will die by the sword, \q those who say, "Disaster will not overtake us or come upon us."
en.R: All the sinners among {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people will be killed by the sword. \q They are the ones who say, "Nothing bad will happen to us."

es.L: A espada morirán todos los pecadores de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, \q los que dicen: «No se acercará ni nos alcanzará la desgracia».
es.B: Todos los pecadores de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo morirán a espada, \q los que dicen: «La desgracia no nos alcanzará ni caerá sobre nosotros».
es.R: Todos los pecadores de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo morirán a espada. \q Son los que dicen: «A nosotros no nos pasará nada malo».

fr.L: Par l’épée mourront tous les pécheurs de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, \q ceux qui disent : « Le malheur n’approchera pas et ne nous atteindra pas. »
fr.B: Tous les pécheurs de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple mourront par l’épée, \q ceux qui disent : « Le malheur ne nous rattrapera pas, il ne viendra pas sur nous. »
fr.R: Tous les pécheurs de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple seront tués par l’épée. \q Ce sont eux qui disent : « Rien de mal ne nous arrivera. »

sw.L: Kwa upanga watakufa wenye dhambi wote wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q wasemao, "Maafa hayatatukaribia wala kutukuta."
sw.B: Wenye dhambi wote kati ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} watakufa kwa upanga, \q wale wanaosema, "Maafa hayatatupata wala kutujia."
sw.R: Wenye dhambi wote kati ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} watauawa kwa upanga. \q Hao ndio wanaosema, "Hakuna jambo baya litakalotupata."

ko.L: 내 백성 가운데 모든 죄인이 칼에 죽을 것이다. \q 그들은 "재앙이 우리에게 가까이 오거나 닥치지 않을 것이다" 하고 말하는 자들이다.
ko.B: 내 백성 가운데 죄를 지은 자들은 모두 칼에 맞아 죽을 것이다. \q 그들은 "재앙이 우리를 따라잡지도 덮치지도 않을 것이다" 하고 말하는 자들이다.
ko.R: 내 백성 가운데 죄를 지은 사람들은 모두 칼에 맞아 죽을 것이다. \q 그들은 "우리에게는 나쁜 일이 일어나지 않을 것이다" 하고 말하는 사람들이다.

vi.L: Mọi kẻ có tội trong dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chết bởi gươm, \q là những kẻ nói: "Tai họa sẽ không đến gần hay gặp chúng ta."
vi.B: Mọi kẻ có tội trong dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chết vì gươm, \q là những kẻ nói: "Tai họa sẽ không đuổi kịp hay ập đến trên chúng ta."
vi.R: Mọi kẻ có tội trong dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bị gươm giết. \q Đó là những kẻ nói: "Chẳng có điều gì xấu xảy đến cho chúng ta."

pt.L: À espada morrerão todos os pecadores do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, \q que dizem: "A desgraça não se aproximará nem nos alcançará."
pt.B: Todos os pecadores do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo morrerão à espada, \q os que dizem: "A desgraça não vai nos alcançar nem cair sobre nós."
pt.R: Todos os pecadores do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo vão ser mortos à espada. \q São eles que dizem: "Nada de mal vai nos acontecer."

am.L: የሕዝቤ ኃጢአተኞች ሁሉ በሰይፍ ይሞታሉ፤ \q «ክፉ ነገር አይቀርብንም፤ አያገኘንምም» የሚሉ።
am.B: ከሕዝቤ መካከል ያሉ ኃጢአተኞች ሁሉ በሰይፍ ይሞታሉ፤ \q እነዚህም፦ «መከራ አይደርስብንም፤ አይመጣብንምም» የሚሉ ናቸው።
am.R: ከሕዝቤ መካከል ያሉ ኃጢአተኞች ሁሉ በሰይፍ ይገደላሉ። \q እነርሱ፦ «ምንም ክፉ ነገር አይደርስብንም» የሚሉ ናቸው።

hi.L: मेरी प्रजा के सब पापी तलवार से मरेंगे, \q जो कहते हैं, "विपत्ति न हमारे निकट आएगी, न हमसे आ मिलेगी।"
hi.B: मेरी प्रजा में के सब पापी तलवार से मरेंगे, \q वे जो कहते हैं, "विपत्ति न हम तक पहुँचेगी, न हम पर आ पड़ेगी।"
hi.R: मेरी प्रजा के सब पापी तलवार से मारे जाएँगे। \q ये वही लोग हैं जो कहते हैं, "हमारा कुछ बुरा नहीं होगा।"

ru.L: От меча умрут все грешники {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} народа, \q говорящие: «Не приблизится и не настигнет нас беда.»
ru.B: Все грешники среди {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} народа умрут от меча, \q те, кто говорит: «Беда не догонит нас и не постигнет.»
ru.R: Все грешники среди {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} народа будут убиты мечом. \q Это они говорят: «С нами ничего плохого не случится.»

ja.L: わたしの民のうちの罪人たちは、みな剣で死ぬ。 \q 「災いはわたしたちに近づかず、わたしたちに臨むこともない」と言う者たちは。
ja.B: わたしの民のうちの罪人たちはみな、剣で死ぬ。 \q 「災いがわたしたちに追いつくことも、襲いかかることもない」と言う者たちは。
ja.R: わたしの民の中の罪人たちはみな、剣で殺される。 \q 彼らは、「わたしたちには何も悪いことは起こらない」と言う者たちだ。

decisions.choice: those who say: the sinners are those who feel sure disaster cannot reach them
decisions.reason: The sinners are named by their false confidence (6:1, 3). Their 'Disaster will not come near us' is the opposite of what Amos has said throughout. Those who die in the sifting (verse 9) are these sinners, not every Israelite.

decisions.choice: Nothing bad will happen to us (R)
decisions.reason: Readable puts the two verbs of the people's saying into one plain sentence.

source.text: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא אָקִ֛ים אֶת־סֻכַּ֥ת דָּוִ֖יד הַנֹּפֶ֑לֶת וְגָדַרְתִּ֣י אֶת־פִּרְצֵיהֶ֗ן וַהֲרִֽסֹתָיו֙ אָקִ֔ים וּבְנִיתִ֖יהָ כִּימֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: In that day I will raise up the booth of David that is fallen, and I will wall up their breaches, and his ruins I will raise up, and I will build it as [in the] days of old,

en.L: In that day \q I will raise up the fallen booth of David, \q and wall up their breaches, and raise up his ruins, \q and rebuild it as in the days of old,
en.B: On that day \q I will raise up the fallen booth of David. \q I will wall up its gaps and restore its ruins \q and rebuild it as it was in days long ago,
en.R: At that time \q I will set up again David's kingdom, which is like a hut that has fallen down. \q I will repair its broken walls and rebuild what was ruined. \q I will build it up again as it was long ago.

es.L: En aquel día \q levantaré la tienda caída de David, \q y cerraré sus brechas, y levantaré sus ruinas, \q y la reedificaré como en los días antiguos,
es.B: Aquel día \q levantaré la tienda caída de David. \q Repararé sus brechas, restauraré sus ruinas \q y la reconstruiré como era en tiempos pasados,
es.R: En ese tiempo \q volveré a levantar el reino de David, que es como una tienda que se ha caído. \q Repararé sus muros rotos y reconstruiré lo que estaba en ruinas. \q Lo levantaré de nuevo como era hace mucho tiempo.

fr.L: En ce jour-là, \q je relèverai la hutte de David qui est tombée, \q et je murerai leurs brèches, et je relèverai ses ruines, \q et je la rebâtirai comme aux jours d’autrefois,
fr.B: Ce jour-là, \q je relèverai la hutte de David qui est tombée. \q Je fermerai ses brèches et je relèverai ses ruines, \q et je la rebâtirai comme elle était aux jours anciens,
fr.R: En ce temps-là, \q je rétablirai la royauté de David, qui est comme une hutte écroulée. \q Je réparerai ses murs abîmés et je rebâtirai ce qui était en ruine. \q Je la reconstruirai comme elle était autrefois.

sw.L: Katika siku ile \q nitaisimamisha hema ya Daudi iliyoanguka, \q na kuziziba nyufa zao, na kuyainua magofu yake, \q na kuijenga kama katika siku za kale,
sw.B: Siku hiyo \q nitaisimamisha tena hema ya Daudi iliyoanguka. \q Nitaziziba nyufa zake na kuyajenga upya magofu yake, \q na kuijenga kama ilivyokuwa siku za zamani,
sw.R: Wakati huo \q nitausimamisha tena ufalme wa Daudi, ulio kama kibanda kilichoanguka. \q Nitazitengeneza kuta zake zilizobomoka na kujenga upya kilichoharibiwa. \q Nitaujenga tena kama ulivyokuwa zamani.

ko.L: 그날에 \q 내가 무너진 다윗의 초막을 일으키고, \q 그들의 터진 곳을 막으며, 그의 허물어진 것을 일으켜, \q 옛날처럼 그것을 다시 세우겠다.
ko.B: 그날에 \q 내가 무너진 다윗의 초막을 다시 일으키겠다. \q 그 터진 곳을 막고 허물어진 곳을 다시 세우며, \q 옛날 모습대로 그것을 다시 짓겠다.
ko.R: 그때에 \q 나는 무너진 초막 같은 다윗의 나라를 다시 세우겠다. \q 무너진 담을 고치고 허물어진 곳을 다시 짓겠다. \q 오래전 모습대로 다시 세우겠다.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dựng lại lều của Đa-vít đã đổ, \q và xây lấp những chỗ nứt vỡ của chúng, và dựng lại những chỗ đổ nát của người, \q và xây lại nó như những ngày xưa,
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dựng lại lều của Đa-vít đã đổ. \q Ta sẽ xây lấp những chỗ nứt vỡ của nó, khôi phục những chỗ đổ nát \q và xây lại nó như thuở xa xưa,
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dựng lại vương quốc của Đa-vít, là vương quốc giống như một cái lều đã sụp đổ. \q Ta sẽ sửa lại những bức tường đổ vỡ và xây lại những gì đã bị phá hủy. \q Ta sẽ xây nó lên lại như xưa kia.

pt.L: Naquele dia \q levantarei a cabana caída de Davi, \q e taparei as brechas delas, e levantarei as ruínas dele, \q e a reconstruirei como nos dias antigos,
pt.B: Naquele dia \q levantarei a cabana caída de Davi. \q Taparei as suas brechas e restaurarei as suas ruínas \q e a reconstruirei como era nos dias de muito tempo atrás,
pt.R: Naquele dia \q vou levantar de novo o reino de Davi, que é como uma cabana que caiu. \q Vou consertar os seus muros quebrados e reconstruir o que foi destruído. \q Vou construí-lo de novo como era muito tempo atrás.

am.L: በዚያ ቀን \q የወደቀችውን የዳዊትን ድንኳን አቆማለሁ፤ \q ክፍተቶቻቸውንም እደፍናለሁ፤ ፍርስራሾቹንም አቆማለሁ፤ \q እንደ ቀድሞው ዘመንም እሠራታለሁ፤
am.B: በዚያ ቀን \q የወደቀችውን የዳዊትን ድንኳን እንደ ገና አቆማለሁ። \q ክፍተቶቿን እዘጋለሁ፤ ፍርስራሿንም መልሼ እገነባለሁ፤ \q በጥንት ዘመን እንደ ነበረችም አድርጌ እሠራታለሁ፤
am.R: በዚያ ቀን \q እንደ ወደቀ ድንኳን የሆነውን የዳዊትን መንግሥት እንደ ገና አቆማለሁ። \q የፈረሱትን ቅጥሮቹን እጠግናለሁ፤ የፈረሰውንም መልሼ እገነባለሁ። \q ከጥንት እንደ ነበረውም አድርጌ እሠራዋለሁ።

hi.L: उस दिन \q मैं दाऊद की गिरी हुई झोपड़ी को खड़ा करूँगा, \q और उनकी दरारों को बंद करूँगा, और उसके खंडहरों को फिर खड़ा करूँगा, \q और उसे प्राचीन काल के दिनों के समान फिर से बनाऊँगा,
hi.B: उस दिन \q मैं दाऊद की गिरी हुई झोपड़ी को फिर खड़ा करूँगा। \q मैं उसकी दरारें भर दूँगा और उसके खंडहरों को फिर से बनाऊँगा \q और उसे वैसा ही बनाऊँगा जैसी वह बहुत पहले के दिनों में थी,
hi.R: उस दिन \q मैं दाऊद के राज्य को फिर खड़ा करूँगा, जो गिरी हुई झोपड़ी जैसा हो गया है। \q मैं उसकी टूटी दीवारें ठीक करूँगा और जो उजड़ गया है उसे फिर बनाऊँगा। \q मैं उसे फिर से वैसा ही बनाऊँगा जैसा वह बहुत पहले था।

ru.L: В тот день \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} подниму упавший шатёр Давида, \q и заделаю их проломы, и его развалины подниму, \q и отстрою его, как во дни древние,
ru.B: В тот день \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} восстановлю упавший шатёр Давида. \q Я заделаю его проломы, подниму его развалины \q и отстрою его, каким он был в древние дни,
ru.R: В тот день \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} снова поставлю царство Давида, которое похоже на упавший шатёр. \q Я заделаю его разрушенные стены и восстановлю то, что было разрушено. \q Я снова построю его таким, каким оно было давным-давно.

ja.L: その日には、 \q わたしはダビデの倒れた仮小屋を起こし、 \q それらの破れ口をふさぎ、その廃墟を起こし、 \q 昔の日々のようにそれを建て直す。
ja.B: その日には、 \q わたしはダビデの倒れた仮小屋を起こす。 \q その破れたところを修理し、崩れたところを建て直し、 \q 遠い昔の日々のように、それを再び建てる。
ja.R: そのとき、 \q わたしは、倒れてしまった小屋のようなダビデの王国を、もう一度建てる。 \q 壊れた城壁を直し、崩れたところを建て直す。 \q 昔のように、それを再び建てる。

decisions.choice: the fallen booth of David: David's royal house and kingdom, brought low
decisions.reason: A sukkah is a booth or hut of branches, the shelter of a watchman or of the Feast of Booths. David's house, once a palace, is pictured as a hut, and a fallen one. It stands for the line of David's kings and the kingdom they ruled, which had split in two after Solomon and was to fall. The LORD promises to restore it as in the days of David, when all Israel was one kingdom under one king.

decisions.choice: their breaches, his ruins, rebuild it: the pronouns change
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says 'their breaches' (feminine plural), 'his ruins' and 'rebuild it' (feminine singular). 'Their' may refer to the two kingdoms, Israel and Judah, or to the walls of the booth; 'his' to David; 'it' to the booth. All refer to the one house of David.

decisions.choice: quoted by James in Acts 15:16-17, following the Greek
decisions.reason: At the council in Jerusalem, James quotes verses 11-12 to show that the prophets foresaw Gentiles seeking the Lord (Acts 15:16-17). He follows the Greek translation, which differs from the Hebrew in verse 12 (see the note there) and has 'tent' for 'booth'. The Hebrew is translated here as it stands.

decisions.choice: booth (L, B); David's kingdom ... like a hut (R); their \q his (L), its (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the changing pronouns (m2); Balanced and Readable say 'its' throughout. Readable says what the booth stands for (m1) and keeps the picture as 'a hut'. Literal and Balanced end with a comma, because the sentence goes on into verse 12.

decisions.choice: "la tienda caída de David" (L, B); "el reino de David, que es como una tienda que se ha caído" (R)
decisions.reason: Sukkah is a booth or hut; Spanish keeps "tienda", the word of Spanish Acts 15:16 (L, B, R), so the reader can see James's quotation, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "sus brechas ... sus ruinas ... la reedificaré" (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pronouns change (their, his, it); Spanish "sus" covers both "their" and "his", so the change is seen only in "la".

decisions.choice: "la hutte de David qui est tombée" (L, B); "la royauté de David, qui est comme une hutte écroulée" (R); "je relèverai", "je rebâtirai", "ses ruines"
decisions.reason: Acts 15:16 has "tente" from the Greek; the Hebrew word is a booth or hut, so French keeps "hutte" with the term sheet, while sharing Acts' verbs and "ses ruines" so the quotation can be recognized. Literal keeps the Hebrew's shifting pronouns ("leurs", "ses").

decisions.choice: "hema ya Daudi iliyoanguka" (L, B); "kama kibanda kilichoanguka" (R)
decisions.reason: James quotes this verse in Acts 15:16, and the Swahili of Acts says "hema ya Daudi iliyoanguka"; the Hebrew sukkah is a booth or hut, so Readable, which explains the picture, says "kibanda". At Literal the pronouns change (their, his, it) as in the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "무너진 다윗의 초막" (L, B); "무너진 초막 같은 다윗의 나라" (R)
decisions.reason: *Sukkah* is a booth or hut ("초막"); Acts 15:16 has "장막" because James quotes the Greek. The term sheet keeps the Hebrew word and marks the choice uncertain.

decisions.choice: "lều của Đa-vít đã đổ" (L, B); "vương quốc ... giống như một cái lều đã sụp đổ" (R)
decisions.reason: The booth keeps the wording of the published Acts 15:16, where James quotes this verse from the Greek; Readable explains the picture, as the English Readable and Acts 15:16 R do. Literal keeps the Hebrew's changing pronouns ("của chúng", "của người", "nó").

decisions.choice: a cabana caída de Davi
alternatives: a tenda de Davi, que caiu (Acts 15:16)
decisions.reason: James quotes verses 11-12 from the Greek in Acts 15:16-17 (m3). Acts' Portuguese says "a tenda de Davi, que caiu", for the Greek tent. The Hebrew has sukkah, a booth or hut of branches (m1), the word of the Feast of Booths ("Cabanas"), so Amos follows the Hebrew with "cabana", which keeps Acts' picture of a poor shelter fallen down. Literal keeps the changing pronouns, "delas" and "dele" (m2).

decisions.choice: the fallen booth of David "የወደቀችው የዳዊት ድንኳን", as Acts 15:16; "ፍርስራሿንም መልሼ እገነባለሁ" (B) and "የፈረሰውን መልሼ እገነባለሁ" (R) as there
alternatives: "የዳዊት ዳስ" (booth, as the Feast of Booths "የዳስ በዓል")
decisions.reason: James quotes these lines in Acts 15:16, so the Amharic of Acts is kept where the Hebrew agrees with the Greek. The Hebrew sukkah is a booth or hut rather than a tent; "ድንኳን" covers a temporary shelter and keeps the link with Acts, which the English loses in choosing "booth". Literal follows the Hebrew's changing pronouns ("their" breaches, "his" ruins, "it"), which Acts smooths; Readable says the booth stands for David's kingdom, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: दाऊद की गिरी हुई झोपड़ी; खंडहर, फिर से बनाऊँगा, फिर खड़ा करूँगा as Acts 15:16
decisions.reason: James quotes verses 11-12 in Acts 15:16-17 from the Greek Old Testament (meaning decision m3), which has "tent" (तंबू) and "after these things I will return". The Hindi translates the Hebrew, sukkah, a booth or hut (झोपड़ी, as in झोपड़ियों का पर्व), and "in that day", and keeps Acts' verbs and खंडहर where the Hebrew agrees. Literal keeps the changing pronouns (m2).

decisions.choice: упавший шатёр Давида
decisions.reason: James quotes 9:11-12 in Acts 15:16-17, following the Greek (meaning decision). The booth is "шатёр", the word of Acts 15:16 at Balanced and Readable; "скиния" is kept for the tabernacle. The Hebrew's "in that day" and "as in the days of old" are translated where Acts has "after this I will return".

decisions.choice: их проломы ... его развалины
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's changing pronouns (meaning decision), as the English Literal.

decisions.choice: sukkat David hannofelet "ダビデの倒れた仮小屋" (L, B), "倒れてしまった小屋のようなダビデの王国" (R); sukkah as Isaiah 1:8 (仮小屋). Acts 15:16 Japanese ("倒れたダビデの幕屋", from the Greek skēnē) was checked; the Hebrew word is kept here.
decisions.reason: Translate from the Hebrew (ISA_GUIDE): sukkah is a booth or hut, a picture of David's house brought low (m1); the Acts wording follows the Septuagint (m3).

decisions.choice: The changing pronouns kept at L ("それらの破れ口", "その廃墟", "それを"); B and R use one referent.
decisions.reason: m2: the pronouns change in the Hebrew; the English L keeps their/his/it and B, R its.

records.literal_gloss: so that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations over which my name is called, declares Yahweh, who does this.

en.L: so that they may take possession of the remnant of Edom \q and all the nations over which {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name is called, \q declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who does this.
en.B: so that they may possess what is left of Edom \q and every nation that is called by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, \q declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who will do this.
en.R: Then they will take over what is left of Edom \q and all the nations that belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who will make this happen.

es.L: para que posean el remanente de Edom \q y todas las naciones sobre las cuales es invocado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, \q declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que hace esto.
es.B: para que posean lo que quede de Edom \q y todas las naciones que llevan {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, \q afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que hará esto.
es.R: Entonces se quedarán con lo que quede de Edom \q y con todas las naciones que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenecen, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que hará que esto suceda.

fr.L: afin qu’ils possèdent le reste d’Édom \q et toutes les nations sur lesquelles {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom est invoqué, \q déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui fait cela.
fr.B: afin qu’ils prennent possession de ce qui reste d’Édom \q et de toutes les nations qui portent {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, \q déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui accomplira cela.
fr.R: Alors ils prendront ce qui reste d’Édom \q et toutes les nations qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartiennent, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui fera arriver cela.

sw.L: ili wamiliki mabaki ya Edomu \q na mataifa yote ambayo juu yao jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} limeitwa, \q asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, afanyaye haya.
sw.B: ili wamiliki kile kilichobaki cha Edomu \q na kila taifa linaloitwa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, \q asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, atakayefanya haya.
sw.R: Ndipo watachukua kile kilichobaki cha Edomu \q na mataifa yote yaliyo mali {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, \q anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, atakayefanya mambo haya yatukie.

ko.L: 그리하여 그들이 에돔의 남은 자와 \q 내 이름으로 불리는 모든 민족을 차지하게 하겠다. \q 이 일을 행하는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 그리하여 그들이 에돔의 남은 땅과 \q 내 이름으로 불리는 모든 민족을 차지하게 하겠다. \q 이 일을 이룰 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 그러면 그들이 에돔의 남은 땅과 \q 내게 속한 모든 민족을 차지할 것이다. \q 이 일을 이룰 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

vi.L: để chúng chiếm lấy những kẻ sót lại của Ê-đôm \q và mọi dân tộc được gọi bằng danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, là Đấng làm điều này.
vi.B: để họ chiếm hữu phần còn lại của Ê-đôm \q và mọi dân tộc được gọi bằng danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng sẽ làm điều này phán vậy.
vi.R: Bấy giờ họ sẽ chiếm lấy phần còn lại của Ê-đôm \q và mọi dân tộc thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng sẽ làm cho điều này xảy ra phán.

pt.L: para que possuam o resto de Edom \q e todas as nações sobre as quais o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome é invocado, \q declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que faz isto.
pt.B: para que tomem posse do que restar de Edom \q e de todas as nações que são chamadas pelo {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome, \q declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que fará isto.
pt.R: Então eles vão ficar com o que sobrar de Edom \q e com todas as nações que pertencem a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, \q diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que vai fazer isso acontecer.

am.L: ይኸውም የኤዶምን ቅሬታ፣ \q ስሜም የተጠራባቸውን አሕዛብ ሁሉ እንዲወርሱ ነው፣ \q ይህን የሚያደርግ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይላል።
am.B: ይኸውም ከኤዶም የቀረውን፣ \q በስሜም የተጠሩትን አሕዛብ ሁሉ እንዲወርሱ ነው፣ \q ይህን የሚያደርግ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይላል።
am.R: ያን ጊዜ ከኤዶም የቀረውን፣ \q የራሴ ያደረግኋቸውንም ሕዝቦች ሁሉ ይወርሳሉ፣ \q ይህን የሚፈጽም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይላል።

hi.L: ताकि वे एदोम के बचे हुओं पर \q और उन सब जातियों पर अधिकार करें जिन पर मेरा नाम पुकारा गया है, \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, जो यह करते हैं।
hi.B: ताकि वे एदोम के बचे हुए भाग पर \q और उन सब देशों पर, जो मेरे नाम से कहलाते हैं, अधिकार कर लें, \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, जो यह करेंगे।
hi.R: तब वे एदोम के बचे हुए भाग को ले लेंगे \q और उन सब देशों को भी जो मेरे अपने हैं, \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं, जो यह करके दिखाएँगे।

ru.L: чтобы они овладели остатком Едома \q и всеми народами, над которыми наречено {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} имя, \q — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, творящего это.
ru.B: чтобы они овладели тем, что осталось от Едома, \q и всеми народами, которые называются {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} именем, \q — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, который совершит это.
ru.R: Тогда они займут то, что осталось от Едома, \q и все народы, которые принадлежат {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}, \q — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, который сделает это.

ja.L: それは、彼らがエドムの残りの者と、 \q わたしの名がその上に呼ばれているすべての国々を所有するためである。 \q ――このことを行う{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――
ja.B: それは、彼らがエドムの残った者と、 \q わたしの名で呼ばれるすべての国を所有するためである、 \q と、このことを行う{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。
ja.R: そうして、彼らは、エドムの残った土地と、 \q わたしのものであるすべての国々を手に入れる、 \q と、このことを成し遂げる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。

decisions.choice: the nations over which my name is called: nations that belong to the LORD
decisions.reason: To call someone's name over a thing is to claim it as one's own (2 Samuel 12:28; Jeremiah 7:10). The nations around Israel that David once ruled (2 Samuel 8) are named as belonging to the LORD.

decisions.choice: Acts 15:17 follows the Greek: 'so that the rest of humankind may seek the Lord'
decisions.reason: The Greek translation that James quotes reads 'so that the rest of humankind may seek' (the Lord). It seems to have read the Hebrew 'they may possess' (yireshu) as 'they may seek' (yidreshu), which has one more letter, and 'Edom' as 'adam, 'humankind', which is written with the same consonants. The Hebrew speaks of the restored kingdom of David ruling over Edom and the nations, as David once did; the Greek speaks of the nations seeking the Lord. James uses the Greek to show that God's purpose includes the Gentiles. The Hebrew already says that the nations are called by the LORD's name.

decisions.choice: the remnant of Edom: Edom, Israel's neighbor and old enemy
decisions.reason: Edom, south-east of the Dead Sea, was ruled by David (2 Samuel 8:14) and later broke free (2 Kings 8:20). Amos has condemned it (1:11-12).

decisions.choice: called by my name (B); belong to me (R); will do this (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom (m1). 'Who does this' is a present form that speaks of what the LORD is about to do, so Balanced and Readable say 'will do'.

decisions.choice: "sobre las cuales es invocado mi nombre" (L); "que llevan mi nombre" (B)
decisions.reason: Worded as Spanish Acts 15:17 L and B where the Hebrew says the same; the first line follows the Hebrew "Edom", where Acts follows the Greek, as the meaning footnote explains.

decisions.choice: "sur lesquelles mon nom est invoqué" (L), "qui portent mon nom" (B)
decisions.reason: The published French Acts 15:17 uses these words for the nations; its first line follows the Greek (the meaning decision), so French keeps the Hebrew's "le reste d'Édom".

decisions.choice: "wamiliki mabaki ya Edomu" from the Hebrew; "juu yao jina langu limeitwa" (L) as Acts 15:17 L
decisions.reason: Acts 15:17 follows the Greek, "so that the rest of humankind may seek the Lord"; the Hebrew speaks of possessing the remnant of Edom, so only the second line shares the wording of Acts.

decisions.choice: "내 이름으로 불리는 모든 민족" (L, B), as the Korean Acts 15:17
decisions.reason: James quotes the Greek, which reads "so that the rest of humankind may seek the Lord"; Korean keeps the Hebrew "possess the remnant of Edom" and shares only the phrase the two have in common.

decisions.choice: "chiếm lấy những kẻ sót lại của Ê-đôm"
alternatives: "để những người còn lại của loài người tìm kiếm Chúa" (Acts 15:17)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says Israel will possess the remnant of Edom; Acts 15:17 follows the Greek ("that the rest of humankind may seek the Lord"). "Mọi dân tộc được gọi bằng danh Ta" is the shared phrase, worded as Acts 15:17.

decisions.choice: possuam o resto de Edom; sobre as quais o meu nome é invocado (L), chamadas pelo meu nome (B)
alternatives: busque o Senhor o resto da humanidade (Acts 15:17)
decisions.reason: Acts 15:17 follows the Greek, "para que o resto da humanidade busque o Senhor" (m2). The Hebrew says that they will possess the remnant of Edom, so Amos follows the Hebrew. Where the Hebrew and Acts agree, the Portuguese keeps Acts' words: "o meu nome foi invocado" (L) becomes "é invocado", and "chamadas pelo meu nome" (B).

decisions.choice: the Hebrew "possess the remnant of Edom" ("የኤዶምን ቅሬታ ... እንዲወርሱ") is followed, not Acts 15:17's "so that the rest of humankind may seek the Lord"; the rest keeps Acts' wording: "ይኸውም ...", "ስሜም የተጠራባቸው አሕዛብ ሁሉ" (L), "በስሜ የተጠሩት አሕዛብ ሁሉ" (B), "የራሴ ያደረግኋቸው ሕዝቦች ሁሉ" (R), "ይህን የሚያደርግ ... ይላል"
decisions.reason: Acts quotes the Greek translation, which read Edom (ʾedom) as humankind (ʾadam) and "possess" as "seek". Here the Hebrew differs from the Greek, so Amos follows the Hebrew for that line, and keeps the Amharic of Acts where the two agree. The speaker is the divine name in its setting where Acts has "ጌታ" for kyrios.

decisions.choice: एदोम के बचे हुओं पर अधिकार करें; जिन पर मेरा नाम पुकारा गया है (L), जो मेरे नाम से कहलाते हैं (B), as Acts 15:17
alternatives: ताकि बाक़ी मनुष्य प्रभु को ढूँढ़ें (Acts 15:17)
decisions.reason: Acts 15:17 follows the Greek, "so that the rest of humankind may seek the Lord" (meaning decision m2); the Hebrew says that Israel will possess the remnant of Edom. The Hindi translates the Hebrew and keeps Acts' words for the nations called by God's name at Literal and Balanced. Edom is एदोम, as the earlier books.

decisions.choice: овладели остатком Едома; народы, над которыми наречено моё имя (L) / которые называются моим именем (B)
decisions.reason: Acts 15:17 follows the Greek, "so that the rest of humankind may seek the Lord" (meaning decision); the Hebrew's possessing of Edom is translated. The second line and "who does this" keep Acts 15:17's wording at Literal and Balanced, where the Hebrew agrees.

decisions.choice: From the Hebrew ("エドムの残りの者…を所有する"), not Acts 15:17's Greek ("人々の残りの者が主を求める"); "わたしの名がその上に呼ばれている" (L) is the same phrase as Acts 15:17 L.
decisions.reason: The footnote (m2) gives the Greek reading James quotes.

records.literal_gloss: Look, days [are] coming, declares Yahweh, and the plowman will overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes the one who sows the seed; and the mountains will drip sweet wine, and all the hills will melt.

en.L: Look, days are coming, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and the plowman will overtake the reaper, \q and the one treading grapes the one sowing the seed; \q and the mountains will drip sweet wine, \q and all the hills will melt.
en.B: The days are coming, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q when the one who plows will catch up with the one who reaps, \q and the one who treads grapes with the one who sows the seed. \q The mountains will drip with sweet wine, \q and all the hills will flow with it.
en.R: The time is coming, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q when the harvest will be so big that the reapers are still at work when it is time to plow again. \q The grapes will still be pressed when it is time to plant. \q Sweet wine will drip from the mountains \q and flow down all the hills.

es.L: He aquí, vienen días, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q en que el que ara alcanzará al que siega, \q y el que pisa las uvas al que siembra la semilla; \q y los montes destilarán vino dulce, \q y todas las colinas se derretirán.
es.B: Vienen días, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q en que el que ara alcanzará al que cosecha, \q y el que pisa las uvas al que siembra la semilla. \q Los montes destilarán vino dulce, \q y de todas las colinas fluirá.
es.R: Viene el tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q en que la cosecha será tan grande que los segadores todavía estarán trabajando cuando llegue el tiempo de volver a arar. \q Todavía estarán pisando las uvas cuando llegue el tiempo de sembrar. \q De los montes goteará vino dulce, \q y correrá por todas las colinas.

fr.L: Voici, des jours viennent, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q où le laboureur rattrapera le moissonneur, \q et celui qui foule les raisins celui qui sème la semence ; \q et les montagnes ruisselleront de vin doux, \q et toutes les collines fondront.
fr.B: Des jours viennent, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q où celui qui laboure suivra de près celui qui moissonne, \q et celui qui foule le raisin celui qui sème. \q Les montagnes ruisselleront de vin doux, \q et toutes les collines en seront inondées.
fr.R: Un temps vient, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q où la récolte sera si grande que les moissonneurs travailleront encore quand il faudra labourer de nouveau. \q On pressera encore le raisin quand il faudra semer. \q Le vin doux coulera des montagnes \q et ruissellera sur toutes les collines.

sw.L: Tazama, siku zinakuja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na mlimaji atamfikia mvunaji, \q naye akanyagaye zabibu atamfikia apandaye mbegu; \q na milima itadondosha divai tamu, \q na vilima vyote vitayeyuka.
sw.B: Siku zinakuja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q ambapo mlimaji atamfikia mvunaji, \q naye akanyagaye zabibu atamfikia apandaye mbegu. \q Milima itadondosha divai tamu, \q na vilima vyote vitatiririka nayo.
sw.R: Wakati unakuja, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q ambapo mavuno yatakuwa mengi sana hata wavunaji bado watakuwa kazini wakati wa kulima tena utakapofika. \q Zabibu bado zitakuwa zikikanyagwa wakati wa kupanda utakapofika. \q Divai tamu itadondoka kutoka milimani \q na kutiririka katika vilima vyote.

ko.L: 보라, 날들이 오고 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. \q 그때에 밭 가는 자가 곡식 거두는 자를 따라잡고, \q 포도 밟는 자가 씨 뿌리는 자를 [따라잡을 것이다]. \q 산들이 단 포도주를 떨어뜨리고, \q 모든 언덕이 녹아 흐를 것이다.
ko.B: 날들이 오고 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 그때에는 밭 가는 사람이 곡식 거두는 사람을 따라잡고, \q 포도 밟는 사람이 씨 뿌리는 사람을 따라잡을 것이다. \q 산들에서는 단 포도주가 뚝뚝 떨어지고, \q 모든 언덕에서 포도주가 흘러내릴 것이다.
ko.R: 그때가 오고 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 그때에는 곡식이 너무 많아서, 다시 밭을 갈 때가 되어도 아직 거두는 일이 끝나지 않을 것이다. \q 씨를 뿌릴 때가 되어도 여전히 포도를 밟고 있을 것이다. \q 산들에서는 단 포도주가 흘러내리고, \q 모든 언덕마다 포도주가 넘쳐흐를 것이다.

vi.L: Này, những ngày sắp đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q khi người cày sẽ theo kịp người gặt, \q và người đạp nho theo kịp người gieo giống; \q núi non sẽ nhỏ giọt rượu ngọt, \q và mọi đồi sẽ tan chảy.
vi.B: Những ngày sắp đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q khi người cày sẽ đuổi kịp người gặt, \q và người đạp nho đuổi kịp người gieo giống. \q Núi non sẽ nhỏ giọt rượu ngọt, \q và mọi đồi sẽ tràn đầy rượu.
vi.R: Thời kỳ sắp đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, \q khi mùa gặt lớn đến nỗi thợ gặt vẫn còn làm việc lúc đã đến mùa cày. \q Người ta vẫn còn ép nho lúc đã đến mùa gieo giống. \q Rượu ngọt sẽ nhỏ giọt từ núi non \q và chảy xuống khắp các đồi.

pt.L: Eis que vêm dias, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q em que o lavrador alcançará o ceifeiro, \q e o que pisa as uvas, o que lança a semente; \q e os montes gotejarão vinho doce, \q e todas as colinas se derreterão.
pt.B: Vem um tempo, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q em que quem ara alcançará quem colhe, \q e quem pisa as uvas, quem semeia. \q Os montes gotejarão vinho doce, \q e todas as colinas correrão com ele.
pt.R: Vem um tempo, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q em que a colheita vai ser tão grande que os ceifeiros ainda vão estar trabalhando quando chegar a hora de arar de novo. \q As uvas ainda vão estar sendo pisadas quando chegar a hora de plantar. \q Vinho doce vai pingar dos montes \q e escorrer por todas as colinas.

am.L: እነሆ፣ ቀኖች ይመጣሉ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ \q አራሹም አጫጁን ይደርስበታል፤ \q ወይን የሚረግጠውም ዘር የሚዘራውን [ይደርስበታል]፤ \q ተራሮች ጣፋጭ የወይን ጠጅ ያንጠባጥባሉ፤ \q ኮረብቶችም ሁሉ ይቀልጣሉ።
am.B: ቀኖች ይመጣሉ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ \q አራሹ አጫጁን፣ \q ወይን የሚጨምቀውም ዘር የሚዘራውን የሚደርስበት። \q ተራሮች ጣፋጭ የወይን ጠጅ ያንጠባጥባሉ፤ \q ኮረብቶችም ሁሉ በእርሱ ይፈሳሉ።
am.R: ጊዜ ይመጣል፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ \q መከሩ ከመብዛቱ የተነሣ እንደ ገና የሚታረስበት ጊዜ ሲደርስ አጫጆች ገና በሥራ ላይ የሚሆኑበት። \q እንደ ገና የሚዘራበት ጊዜ ሲደርስ ወይን ገና ይጨመቃል። \q ጣፋጭ የወይን ጠጅ ከተራሮች ይንጠባጠባል፤ \q በኮረብቶችም ሁሉ ላይ ይፈሳል።

hi.L: देखो, ऐसे दिन आ रहे हैं, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, \q कि हल चलानेवाला लवनेवाले को, \q और अंगूर रौंदनेवाला बीज बोनेवाले को जा पकड़ेगा; \q और पहाड़ों से मीठा दाखमधु टपकेगा, \q और सब पहाड़ियाँ पिघल जाएँगी।
hi.B: ऐसे दिन आ रहे हैं, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, \q जब हल चलानेवाला लवनेवाले से जा मिलेगा, \q और अंगूर रौंदनेवाला बीज बोनेवाले से। \q पहाड़ों से मीठा दाखमधु टपकेगा, \q और सब पहाड़ियों से वह बह निकलेगा।
hi.R: ऐसा समय आ रहा है, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं, \q जब फ़सल इतनी बड़ी होगी कि लवनेवाले अभी काम ही कर रहे होंगे और फिर से हल चलाने का समय आ जाएगा। \q अंगूर अभी रौंदे ही जा रहे होंगे और बोने का समय आ जाएगा। \q पहाड़ों से मीठा दाखमधु टपकेगा \q और सब पहाड़ियों से बह निकलेगा।

ru.L: Вот, приходят дни, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — \q и пахарь настигнет жнеца, \q и топчущий виноград — сеющего семя; \q и горы будут источать молодое вино, \q и все холмы растают.
ru.B: Вот, приходят дни, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — \q когда пахарь догонит жнеца, \q а давящий виноград — сеятеля. \q Горы будут источать молодое вино, \q и все холмы потекут им.
ru.R: Настанет время, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — \q когда урожай будет так велик, что жнецы ещё будут работать, когда придёт время снова пахать. \q Виноград ещё будут давить, когда придёт время сеять. \q С гор будет капать молодое вино \q и стекать по всем холмам.

ja.L: 見なさい、日々が来る。――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉―― \q 耕す者は刈る者に追いつき、 \q ぶどうを踏む者は種を蒔く者に[追いつく]。 \q 山々は甘いぶどう酒を滴らせ、 \q すべての丘は溶けて流れる。
ja.B: その日々が来る、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。 \q そのとき、耕す者は刈り入れる者に追いつき、 \q ぶどうを踏む者は種を蒔く者に追いつく。 \q 山々は甘いぶどう酒を滴らせ、 \q すべての丘はそれで潤い流れる。
ja.R: その時が来る、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。 \q そのときには、収穫があまりにも多くて、刈り入れがまだ終わらないうちに、もう次に耕す時が来る。 \q ぶどうを搾っているうちに、もう種を蒔く時が来る。 \q 山々からは甘いぶどう酒が滴り、 \q すべての丘を流れ下る。

decisions.choice: the plowman will overtake the reaper: harvests so large that one season runs into the next
decisions.reason: Plowing came in the autumn, after the summer's harvests, and sowing followed; grapes were trodden in late summer. The harvest will be so great that the reapers are still at work when the plowmen come, and the grapes are still being trodden when it is time to sow. Leviticus 26:5 promises the same kind of plenty to an obedient Israel.

decisions.choice: the mountains will drip sweet wine: also in Joel 4:18
decisions.reason: Joel 4:18 has nearly the same line. The hills 'melt' or 'flow', as if the vines on their slopes ran with wine.

decisions.choice: Look, days are coming (L); The days are coming (B); The time is coming (R); will flow with it (B, R)
decisions.reason: The formula follows 8:11. Balanced and Readable say 'flow' for 'melt', with 'it', the wine, supplied (m2). Readable explains the picture of the harvests (m1).

decisions.choice: "los montes destilarán vino dulce" (L, B); "De los montes goteará vino dulce" (R)
decisions.reason: Joel 4:18 has the same words, and the Spanish keeps one wording for both at each level.

decisions.choice: "les montagnes ruisselleront de vin doux" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The same words as Joel 4:18, worded the same in French.

decisions.choice: "산들이 단 포도주를 떨어뜨리고" (L), "산들에서는 단 포도주가 뚝뚝 떨어지고" (B), "…흘러내리고" (R), as Joel 4:18
decisions.reason: The same words close Joel; Korean keeps them alike.

decisions.choice: "núi non sẽ nhỏ giọt rượu ngọt" at each level as Joel 4:18
decisions.reason: The line is shared with Joel 4:18 and keeps its Vietnamese.

decisions.choice: os montes gotejarão vinho doce (L, B); vinho doce vai pingar dos montes (R)
